item.title: Boundary Representation-Driven Graph Transformer Modeling for Machining Operation Sequencing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

Machining process planning is inherently complex due to the interdependence between part geometry, machining operations, and evolving manufacturable states. Traditional approaches rely heavily on expert knowledge and rule-based systems, limiting scalability and automation. While recent machine learning methods have shown promise, most operate on simplified geometric representations, such as voxels or hand-crafted features, which fail to fully exploit the rich geometric and topological information encoded in Boundary Representation (B-Rep) models. In this work, we propose a graph transformer-based framework for geometry-to-sequence learning that directly predicts machining operation sequences from B-Rep design geometry. The proposed method constructs topology-aware graphs from B-Rep entities, where faces and their adjacencies are encoded as node and edge features capturing both geometric and relational information. A graph neural network encoder learns geometry-aware embeddings, which are then used to condition a dual-decoder transformer that autoregressively generates machining operation sequences. item.title: Attention Temperature Confounds Zero-Shot Context Extension
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

A training-time attention change is usually judged for zero-shot context extension against a dense baseline beyond the training length at the default temperature, $τ= 1$. The outcome depends on how miscalibrated the baseline is there: the share of perplexity it recovers when its logits are sharpened by one scalar. Under the standard recipe (fp32 master weights), an 8k-trained baseline is 8-15% miscalibrated at 30k in three seed-paired 365M twins; in one of them this makes the block-sparse-trained twin look 7% better, which calibration removes. In pure-bf16 training without master weights the miscalibration is several times larger: an AdamW step ($β_2 = 0.95$) on a gain initialised at 1.0 is below half the bf16 spacing at peak learning rates under $1.7\times10^{-3}$, so gains never move (22 checkpoints), the baseline is 37-58% miscalibrated, and block-sparse pretraining, attention dropout and ALiBi look 6-35% better. Calibrating one temperature per model and length removes all three advantages, leaves ALiBi 5% behind RoPE and keeps part of the gain of a positive control, NTK-aware scaling. Unfreezing the gains reverses the block-sparse advantage at 365M and removes 71-89% of it at 1…

item.title: Attention Latent Feedback
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

During autoregressive decoding, the deeper representations of the previous token have already been computed, yet shallow layers at the current token cannot read them directly because standard self-attention connects positions only at the same depth. We introduce Attention Latent Feedback (ALF), an architecture that allows every sublayer to attend to the outputs of the deeper layers at the previous position. Training unrolls this cross-position recurrence into two parallel passes, whereas decoding remains single-pass using cached previous-token states. Across mixture-of-experts models with up to 4.0B parameters, ALF lowers held-out loss by 0.022-0.024 nats over the standard residual with about 1.1% decoding FLOP overhead, and consistently outperforms prior final-state feedback across all three scales on both standard and attention residual backbones. On MoE-1.6B, ALF matches a $1.38\times$ larger baseline token budget, and on MoE-4.0B it lifts average accuracy across seventeen downstream benchmarks from 45.1% to 47.0%. Analysis further reveals that intermediate and nearby deeper layers drive most of this benefit, allowing a fixed nearest-window variant to retain 89%-94% of the gain …

item.title: AnchorCredit: Output-Anchored Credit Assignment for Structured Generation with Multiple Verifiable Rewards
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

In Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and related methods typically compute group-relative advantages from response rewards and broadcast the same advantage to every generated token in a response to guide policy updates. However, we identify a systematic problem of cross-component credit misassignment in tasks with multiple verifiable results, such as joint multi-attribute prediction: low rewards for some components can penalize a well-performing component and its associated reasoning. To address this problem, we propose AnchorCredit. The method uses the policy model's attention from output anchors to preceding reasoning sentences to estimate sentence-component associations and assign component-specific advantages to the relevant reasoning, without additional relevance annotations or a separate relevance discriminator. To support the study of credit assignment with multiple verifiable rewards, we construct ProductAttr, a benchmark of 7,200 real product image-text samples. Experiments show that AnchorCredit outperforms existing baselines on this benchmark. Experiments on the public Nutrition5k dataset further support the …

item.title: AeroPoint: Agentic AI for Intent-Driven Point Cloud Inspection in UAV-Edge Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV)-based Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) inspection generates dense point clouds that strain onboard computing and wireless bandwidth. Intent-based inspection allows operators to request objects, attributes, and spatial relationships through natural language. Answering these requests requires trans- lating intent into spatial queries and retrieving relevant evidence under UAV processing and communication constraints. This article presents AeroPoint, an agentic AI system combining onboard point cloud processing and knowledge graph construction with Large Language Model (LLM)-based retrieval planning at a ground edge server. The LLM translates inspection questions into structured requests, which the UAV executes to return selected graph evidence for answer generation. We evaluate the prototype in a power line inspection case study using 150 TS40K UAV LiDAR scenes and profile processing costs on NVIDIA Jetson Nano hardware. Retrieval experiments use graphs constructed from dataset-provided ground-truth semantic labels. Experimental results show that transmitted payload decreases from 3700 KB for complete point clouds to 3.1 KB for retrieval responses, wh…

item.title: ANOR: Scaling Sparse Attention with a GPU-PNM Computing Hierarchy
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 长上下文 LLM 服务须保留每请求完整 KV 缓存，可能超 GPU 显存；CXL-PNM 设备可持全缓存就地算注意力，但现有 GPU-PNM 系统 PNM 为中心，CXL-PNM 带宽远低于 GPU HBM，使 PNM 成瓶颈、GPU 空等。

方法 ANOR 是 GPU-PNM 联合加速系统：利用稀疏注意力的选择局部性，GPU 从近期选择条目缓存算大部分注意力，PNM 只处理 miss；有界缓存更新策略在命中率饱和点停止更新以减链路流量；片上 Early Streaming Buffer 捕获 KV 数据流给 GPU；自适应缓存因子随负载调 GPU 缓存大小。

关键数字 两模型三长上下文 agentic 负载下，解码吞吐较 HiSparse 平均 2.3x、较 PNM 基线平均 2.0x。

为什么值得看 把 PNM 定位为 GPU 内存层级的计算层而非主引擎，纠正 PNM-centric 设计偏差。

item.title: A Systematic Method of GPU Verification on Subsystem Modelling
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

ARM Fast Model is a software modelling system for simulating multiple systems IPs integrated in a subsystem. Fast Model allows customer to run whole software stack as early as system IPs' specification is just ready. In this paper, we talk about a systematic method to enable GPU modelling and make whole system software stacks executable for both CPU and GPU in the integrated modelling environment, and eventually the major GPU IP can be verified. With our solution, we can directly run commercial benchmarks like Antutu and GFX Bench in Android target system with underlying ARM Fast Model mobile subsystem support. This was unbelievable in the past due to 3D rendering simulation for GPU verification is very slow. We also introduce some special techniques to improve performance. Eventually the whole software stack can directly work on real hardware without any changes as soon as the first tape-out is ready.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: A Pipeline-Parallel System for Depth-Recurrent Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 深度循环（Looped）模型靠共享块栈多次应用提升有效深度，扩展通常需流水线并行；但常用交错 1F1B 为无环 stage 图设计——栈跨 stage 拆分后同一 stage 被多次访问、后级反喂前级，1F1B 无对应槽位、无法排序、无回边，导致停滞或乱序。

方法 Loop-PP 为这种循环布局重建时间表与通信：同一 stage 的不同迭代分别调度，把 1F1B 骨架特化为全局一致的访问序，每 rank 发射静态指令流、分离 posting 与 waiting 使通信与本地计算重叠。

关键数字 与单 stage 参考逐位一致（bit-identical）；8B–60B MoE 模型上峰值内存最多降 32.8%；固定算力预算下最佳观测吞吐提升 12.7%。

为什么值得看 为循环架构定制流水线并行，bit-identical 验证 + 显存与吞吐双收益。

item.content:encoded:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 深度循环（Looped）模型靠共享块栈多次应用提升有效深度，扩展通常需流水线并行；但常用交错 1F1B 为无环 stage 图设计——栈跨 stage 拆分后同一 stage 被多次访问、后级反喂前级，1F1B 无对应槽位、无法排序、无回边，导致停滞或乱序。

方法 Loop-PP 为这种循环布局重建时间表与通信：同一 stage 的不同迭代分别调度，把 1F1B 骨架特化为全局一致的访问序，每 rank 发射静态指令流、分离 posting 与 waiting 使通信与本地计算重叠。

关键数字 与单 stage 参考逐位一致（bit-identical）；8B–60B MoE 模型上峰值内存最多降 32.8%；固定算力预算下最佳观测吞吐提升 12.7%。

为什么值得看 为循环架构定制流水线并行，bit-identical 验证 + 显存与吞吐双收益。

item.title: A CPU-Only Framework for Mining Collectively-Behaving Bots in MMORPGs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

MMORPGs continually face automated programs (bots) that disrupt gameplay balance and in-game economies. An unsupervised Transformer framework can mine collectively behaving bot groups, but its multi-GPU training is costly in live operations. We show that such GPU-trained sequence models are not strictly necessary for this task. Our CPU pipeline pairs zone embeddings learned from movement context, which place teleport-linked zones close together, with a training-free coordinate kernel, and then applies density clustering. It trains 3-5$\times$ faster than the GPU-based Transformer (56-86$\times$ on the same CPU) while matching its mining quality on two commercial MMORPGs, and has been deployed since late 2024. We also share deployment lessons on how to set the clustering threshold and when to retrain.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Ziv Meets Sumcheck: Zero-Knowledge Proofs of Floating-Point LLM Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Zero-knowledge proofs can show that a neural network produced a given output without revealing the network, but current systems for language models prove integer approximations of the model rather than the floating-point arithmetic that is actually deployed. Proving floating-point matrix multiplication has been regarded as hard, because rounding after every addition makes the result depend on the order of the additions. We avoid this obstacle by proving the correctly rounded product, in which every dot product is computed exactly and rounded once. This result is independent of the hardware and at least as accurate as standard kernels. We give an interactive proof for this relation whose cost is close to that of integer matrix multiplication, with roughly a thousand times fewer committed values than per-operation floating-point circuits need constraints, extend it to every layer of a transformer, and give a privacy construction for the complete argument whose zero knowledge we prove under explicit hypotheses. We implement the system and prove the full forward pass of GPT-2 small, including all twelve blocks and the output over the whole vocabulary, in 19 minutes on two processor cor…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Zarc: Exact Nearest Neighbors over a Billion Vectors in Seconds
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 精确 kNN 向量搜索处于 ML 系统关键路径（LLM 稀疏注意力、长上下文记忆、训练去重）；穷举 GPU 搜索逐查询扫全量数据，近似索引返回不精确邻居，近年半精度证明方法只能用于单 GPU 全量驻留。

方法 Zarc 只在 GPU 内存保留证明的短行，少数剩余完整向量从主机内存按需取回；支持欧氏、余弦、内积与过滤查询，更新下仍精确。

关键数字 四张 H100 上对十亿向量回答 10,000 个精确查询仅 1.1 秒（基线约五分钟）；11 个开源 LLM 上精确 top-10 注意力键检索较穷举快 2.2x–13.1x；百万 token 稀疏注意力中较 FlashInfer bf16 选择快 3.1x（后者多数查询漏掉精确 top-64）。

为什么值得看 十亿级精确最近邻秒级返回，稀疏注意力等场景直接受益。

item.title: When Does Decomposition Help? Empirical Study on Workload-Architecture Affinity in LLM Inference Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM 推理可组织为单体副本、张量/流水线并行组或 prefill/decode 分离；分解是否提效取决于工作负载形状、模型适配与相位资源可否独立缩放，而现有比较常同时改动多个因素。

方法 隔离架构效应：同一四卡 A100-40GB 硬件包络、Qwen3-8B、同软件栈/提示/到达调度下评估 5 种 SGLang 服务组织方式；150 个审计条件覆盖短聊、decode 重与 32K prefill 重负载。

关键数字 4 个独立单卡副本在短聊与长输出下端到端延迟最低、且唯一全条件稳定；流水线并行在非压力速率下 32K 首 token 延迟降 58–59%；混合流水线分离在 0.4 req/s 下 32K 端到端最优；静态 TP2+TP2 拆分无改善、高 32K 负载崩溃。

为什么值得看 隔离架构效应的系统性实证，"分解不是单调优化"对服务架构选型有直接指导。

item.title: When Can a Rewiring Control Test LLM Weight Readers? C2 and an Eligibility Protocol
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Large language models can predict the outputs of small neural networks from raw weights, but success could reflect recognition of weight-space regularities (fingerprints) rather than computation, and function-preserving controls cannot tell these apart. We propose C2, a counterfactual that permutes the columns of a network's final linear readout: every other parameter, and the readout's singular values, norms and entry multiset, are unchanged, and the function can change in an exactly recomputable way; we verify that each evaluated permutation does. C2 separates fingerprinting from computation only under three conditions, which we state as an eligibility protocol: a strategy restricted to C2-invariant summaries must already predict the target; C2 must change a property specific to the rewiring; and the reader's identity must be attested. No natural setting we tested is eligible. On tiny MLPs a frontier reader route followed the rewired function on all 24 networks, but invariant baselines were near chance and its backend could not be attested. In two public CNN zoos the conditions traded off: weight statistics predicted CIFAR-10 accuracy in-distribution, but C2's effect on accuracy …

item.title: Towards Global Counterfactual-Based Self-Explainable Graph Neural Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Graph Counterfactual Explanations (GCEs) have emerged as an effective approach for interpreting Graph Neural Network (GNN) predictions by identifying minimal graph modifications needed to change predictions. However, existing methods suffer from two fundamental limitations: (1) They rely on a post-hoc explanation paradigm, where a separate explainer is trained after the GNN. This sequential optimization prevents the explainer from leveraging how the GNN learned its representations, often resulting in lower-quality explanations. (2) They are largely local, generating counterfactual explanations only for individual samples. Consequently, they fail to capture generalizable patterns across the data distribution, a crucial gap for applications like drug discovery, where global principles enable systematic decision-making across thousands of cases. To address these limitations, we propose GCSGNN (Global Counterfactual-based Self-explainable GNN), a unified framework that integrates counterfactual generation into the GNN architecture, encouraging explanations that faithfully reflect the model's decision-making process. Beyond local explanations, GCSGNN discovers shared latent patterns inf…

item.title: Towards Edge Artificial Intelligence for Predicting Antimicrobial Resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in Mycobacterium tuberculosis (MTB) poses a major challenge to global tuberculosis control, as multidrug-resistant strains limit available treatment options. Rapid and accurate prediction of drug resistance from genomic data could support timely treatment decisions and public health interventions. However, many existing computational approaches for genomic AMR prediction rely on computationally intensive pipelines, limiting their suitability for deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. This limitation is particularly relevant in hospital settings in low- and middle-income countries, where computing infrastructure and access to high-performance computational resources may be limited. To address this challenge, we present a lightweight, novel machine learning (ML) approach suitable for running on edge devices that combines 4-mer frequency features derived from whole-genome sequences with a Random Forest classifier to predict antibiotic resistance in MTB. The proposed ML approach achieved an average area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.82 across 20 antibiotics on an independent test set.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: The Complexity of Full-Information Iterated Protocols
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Full-information protocols are a common abstraction in distributed computing. In its iterated form, processes proceed through successive communication rounds in which each process shares its entire current knowledge of the execution. Usually, it is implicitly assumed that a process can transmit an unbounded amount of information in every round. This paper makes that assumption explicit and studies its computational cost. We formalize the problem of simulating iterated full-information protocols when communication is bounded, so that each process may share at most $b$ bits with every other process per round. We show that for a large family of shared-memory communication models and $n+1$ processes, simulating $r$ iterations of the full-information protocol requires \(Ω\!\left((n!)^{r-1} 2^{\,n-b}\right)\) rounds. We complement this lower bound with simulation algorithms that are asymptotically optimal in the conventional read-write model. In particular, the case of two processes is special: $r$ iterations of a full-information protocol can be simulated in exactly $r$ rounds while using only $2$-bit variables, as the amount of information that must be represented remains bounded for t…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Graph foundation models (GFMs) aim to learn transferable representations across domains with heterogeneous node attributes and graph structures. However, relations inferred from node attributes can rely on domain-specific feature semantics, limiting their transferability to unseen graphs, particularly in low-label regimes. We propose THETA (Topology-aware HEat-based TrAnsfer), a graph foundation model that leverages Heat Kernel Signatures (HKS) as a topology-based structural prior for cross-domain transfer. By characterizing nodes' heat-return behavior across diffusion scales, HKS provides a common structural descriptor across graphs without requiring aligned attribute semantics, complementing feature-based relations with information about local and multiscale connectivity. THETA incorporates this prior into both pre-training and few-shot adaptation. During pre-training, it combines HKS with node attributes to construct refined graph views and trains a shared encoder via contrastive learning. item.title: SlotFill: Repairing Lossy SoC Communication Traces for Post-Silicon Validation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Post-silicon validation relies on traces of messages exchanged by SoC components, but trace buffers and monitors drop messages, often leaving no mark of what was lost. We present SlotFill, which puts each deleted message back in the right gap, with the right type and order. SlotFill gives every gap between the remaining messages a fixed number of slots, and a Transformer-based model fills each slot with a message or leaves it empty when nothing was deleted there, so the input never reveals how much was lost. The model also uses monitor fields (timestamps, transaction IDs, addresses) from surviving messages. On whole-program gem5 traces of 4- and 8-core systems (2.07 billion messages), SlotFill restores up to 97% of deleted messages exactly at 15% loss and up to 87% at 50% loss, and 76-83% at 15% loss when timestamps are coarse.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: SleepXA: Composing Pretrained Neural and Cardiac Foundation Models for Sleep Representation Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Physiological signals recorded during sleep provide synchronized views of neural, cardiac, respiratory, and other bodily systems, while preserving modality-specific information. Existing EEG and ECG foundation models already capture rich but distinct physiological structure, motivating an alternative to training a multimodal sleep model from scratch: composing existing pretrained models. We introduce SleepXA, a framework that uses synchronized polysomnography (PSG) to compose independently pretrained neural and cardiac foundation models. SleepXA combines pretrained EEG and ECG encoders with lightweight encoders for additional PSG modalities, and learns shared and modality-specific representations through sleep-guided alignment. We pretrain SleepXA on 9,230 overnight PSG recordings from three large cohorts and evaluate it on 27 downstream tasks spanning sleep representation, clinical and disease prediction, and daytime physiological transfer. SleepXA ranks among the top two methods on 22 of 27 tasks. Controlled experiments further show consistent benefits across sensor configurations and EEG-ECG backbone choices, while pretrained initialization outperforms architecture-matched train…

item.title: Selecting Stable Sampling Dynamics for Compositional Diffusion: A Feynman-Kac Weight Reduction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Given $K$ separately trained diffusion models, how should one sample from a $β_k$-weighted product of their terminal laws without jointly retraining the experts? Existing Feynman--Kac constructions provide many weighted stochastic differential equations (SDEs) with the correct target marginal. The consequential question is how to select useful proposal dynamics among them. We study an explicit family of weighted diffusions that realizes the same product-of-intermediate-experts trajectory. A scalar parameter $λ$ controls how strongly the proposal drift follows the composed expert score, while an additional Langevin component can be varied independently. Writing $B=\sum_{k=1}^{K}β_k>0$, we identify the distinguished choice $λ=1/B$. At this value, the aggregate squared-score term in the instantaneous Feynman--Kac log-weight rate cancels exactly. item.title: RumiFold: Teaching an LLM to Natively Fold Proteins and Reason About Their Function
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Can we teach a general-purpose language model to fold proteins? And if so, what does learning to fold enable beyond structure prediction itself? We introduce RumiFold, a pretrained chat model that learns to predict protein structures directly from its own hidden states. RumiFold processes proteins through repeated folding passes, then uses these folded representations to answer questions in natural language. It achieves folding accuracy comparable to dedicated single-representation models such as SimpleFold, alongside state-of-the-art performance on Gene Ontology protein function prediction and free-text function description. We find that folding pretraining organizes the model's hidden states around protein function, creating an internal per-residue workspace that is biologically grounded. Causal interventions show that this folded workspace links structure and language when RumiFold predicts function, providing rich representations for biomolecular reasoning. We see RumiFold as a step toward native biomolecular intelligence: where protein-based computations and language-based reasoning become integrated capabilities of general-purpose language models. item.title: Recursive Self-Editing: LLMs Program Their Own Weight Edits for Self-Improvement
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Recursive self-improvement asks a system to improve the very system that improves it. Today's language models improve themselves through data, training recipes or scaffolds. Whenever their weights change, gradient descent writes the update, not the model. We let the model write its own weights. In SELFWRITE, each generation the current model studies its own reasoning on fresh training problems, inspects its own weights and activations in a persistent Python session, and writes a program that constructs a low-rank weight edit for itself from white-box primitives (singular directions, activation contrasts between its right and wrong answers, rank-one projections, tensor computations), with no training or gradient tool. Every candidate is graded once on a hidden gate set against the current model; the best strictly improving edit is merged into the weights, and the edited model writes the next edit. On Qwen3.8-27B and math problems from DAPO-Math, five generations of SELFWRITE raise gate accuracy from 73.95% to 76.45% and accuracy on a held-out test split that the loop never sees from 76.30% to 77.75% (avg@4) and from 82.60% to 84.80% (pass@4), without a single gradient step. item.title: QASparse: Query-Adaptive Sparse Attention with Tailored Budgets and Tokens
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 长序列 LLM 推理的 prefill 成本高，密集注意力随上下文长度平方增长；跨 head 相似性可减少冗余计算，但 head 间相似不代表查询需求一致，预算与 token 选择需按查询区域适配。

方法 QASparse 查询自适应稀疏注意力：局部预算回归沿查询位置建模计算需求、为不同查询区域与 head 估预算；边界投票让每个 head 内的查询用真实 query/key 分数对选择截止线附近候选投票，精化保留集；再设计长度特化选择 kernel 支持动态预算执行。

关键数字 较现有稀疏注意力基线改进基准分数并加快 prefill attention 计算（摘要未给出具体量化数字）。

为什么值得看 共享估计 + 局部决策结合的查询自适应稀疏注意力，兼顾效率与硬件执行。

item.title: Pain Reassessment from Pulse Waveforms with Language Model Explanations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Routine photoplethysmography (PPG) offers a continuous physiological signal for pain reassessment between self-reports. Whether prior recordings provide an individualized physiological reference beyond care-process timing remains unresolved. Across 52,082 report-linked assessments from 21,514 patients in MIMIC-III critical care and MC-MED emergency care, we evaluate a workflow that pairs longitudinal PPG representations with local evidence-linked language interpretation. Among 27 methods, source-selected full-history models achieved average precision of 0.824 from critical to emergency care and 0.822 in reverse. Removing historical pulse-run representations while retaining reassessment availability and elapsed time lowered critical-to-emergency four-hour within-patient concordance from 0.718 to 0.534. This comparison supports the contribution of prior pulse-run representations to within-patient ordering beyond timing cues. Across 2,905 test patients, a local Qwen model interpreting frozen predictions achieved a 94.7% patient-equal pass rate on automated evidence checks after at most one revision. Longitudinal pulse context and evidence-linked language interpretation support a patie…

item.title: Ossim: OS-Driven Live Simulation for Cluster-Scale Full-Stack Evaluation (Extended Version)
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 集群规模全栈模拟需同时满足未修改生产栈的全栈保真与迭代配置探索所需的模拟性能，现有方法无法兼得。

方法 Ossim 是构建在 Linux 虚拟化栈上的 OS 级方法，含四个子系统：模拟导向调度、实时内存层级管理、模拟感知 IPC、多主机协调；在共享模拟时间下协调 live 与建模组件、控制共置 live VM 间干扰。

关键数字 论文未披露具体量化指标，聚焦机制设计：让模拟控制与编排成为 OS 核心职责的 simulation-native 方向。

为什么值得看 把模拟控制与编排提升为 OS 原生责任，是集群全栈评估的系统级新思路。

item.title: One Checkpoint, Four Converters: Per Input Disagreement After On Device Conversion and a Probe Set That Catches It
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 设备端/加速推理的模型转换以 top-1 准确率匹配源模型即上线，但准确率匹配时单个决策可能改变；转换器、INT8 配方与校准各有影响。

方法 用 ExecuTorch、LiteRT、ONNX Runtime、TensorRT 的 FP32 与 INT8 文档配方转换 5 个公开 checkpoint（4 个 ImageNet 分类器 + 1 个情感模型），在 7,854 张图与 1,938 个句子上逐 top-1 决策与 PyTorch 源对比。

关键数字 34 个严格 FP32 转换逐决策复现；4 个保准确率的视觉 INT8 配方均翻转 >1% 决策：ONNX Runtime 静态 INT8 翻转 ResNet-50 4.07% 决策（准确率仅 −0.15 点），同配方不同校准构建间分歧 3.44%；200 个最小源 margin 训练输入组成的探针集召回全部 40 个视觉栈（95% CI 0.91–1.00）。

为什么值得看 证明准确率等价 ≠ 决策等价，给出转换前即可选定的探针集做验收。

方法 OnCache 动态缓存框架在线做提示自适应决策：离线在相同去噪状态的成对计算/缓存延续上训练策略，用终端保真度与函数评估数（NFE）差异衡量每个决策的下游后果；神经校正器补偿缓存误差并抑制其沿去噪轨迹累积；组件轻量。

关键数字 FLUX.1-dev 1024² 分辨率近 3x 生成加速，LPIPS 0.156、SSIM 0.860；扩展到 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 视频生成，两模态均达 SOTA 效率-质量权衡。

为什么值得看 提示自适应的扩散缓存调度，训练信号直接来自下游保真度影响。

item.title: NANO: Unifying Missingness and Input Uncertainty in Tabular Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Missing values are common in tabular data, yet current approaches to handling them often overlook two dimensions. First, an observed value may be uncertain, while a Not-Observed (N.O.) value may still have a reasonable estimate. Inputs should therefore span a continuous spectrum from no evidence to a fully trusted observation. Second, Not-Applicable (N.A.) means that no meaningful value exists for a record, yet this semantic state often lacks explicit representation. To address both dimensions, we introduce NANO, a unified plug-in for input encoding that fits most token-based architectures. Guided by Bayesian evidence weighting, NANO adjusts the influence of a supplied value according to confidence, with all zero-confidence estimates mapped to the same N.O. representation. NANO accepts, but does not require, per-example confidence information during training or inference. For N.A., a separate representation enables models to encode inapplicability and its schema-defined reasons into context. Experiments across eleven datasets and nine backbones show that mixed-confidence training enables a single NANO model to generalize across inference confidence levels, remaining competitive wit…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Motivo: A Motif-Based Algorithm-Architecture Co-Design for Fast and Energy-Efficient Graph-Based Genome Analysis
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 读段映射是基因组分析关键步骤；图基因组通过表示群体遗传多样性提升准确率，但序列到图（S2G）映射因图规模与复杂度成为主要瓶颈，先验软硬件方法做大量无效图遍历与动态规划。

方法 观察到基因组图由共享有限重复拓扑（motif）的小子图构成：Motivo 预计算每节点 motif 紧凑索引，用单次内存查找替代图遍历；再用 motif 拓扑与节点属性以算术运算识别最适映射路径；算法-架构协同设计 CPU/GPU/ASIC。

关键数字 Motivo-CPU 较 GraphAligner/vg/minigraph 提速 2.1–18.4x / 2.8–343x / 1.4–10.1x，GPU 较 vg-giraffe 1.5–1.6x；ASIC 较 SOTA CPU 工具短/长读提速 7.4–11.7x / 138–274x；每瓦吞吐较 SeGraM 5.3x、HARP 4.0–4.3x；映射准确率持平 96.8–99.7%。

为什么值得看 基于 motif 的算法-架构协同，为图基因组分析提供完整加速栈。

item.title: Loop-Count Schedules in Looped Transformers: An Empirical Study
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Looped transformers apply one block of layers several times with shared weights, trading parameters for repeated computation. We study how the schedule of the loop iteration count R during training determines whether each extra pass acts as a full layer or as a small correction, using a controlled ladder of 46M-110M-parameter models trained on 2B tokens with learned residual gates on every loop pass and three schedules: R fixed to 2, R sampled uniformly from {1,...,6}, and R sampled from {2,3,4}. We find that the lower bound of the sampling range is the decisive choice. item.title: LiZoneDedup: An End-to-End In-Storage Deduplication Architecture for ZNS SSDs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 数据去重减少写流量、延长闪存寿命，但 ZNS SSD 从未实现存内去重：既无页级 FTL 重映射重复写，也无设备级指纹索引（超出控制器 DRAM）。

方法 关键洞察是 ZNS 的 append-only 契约天然适配去重：重复映射一旦记录就不原地改，去重元数据变成 append-only 日志而非可变页级表，指纹放进紧凑的每区域索引而非全局索引；配套设备选择写原语、内容路由与生命周期分离元数据。

关键数字 1TB ZNS SSD 上约 10.7GB 全局指纹索引换成每区域几百 KB（密封后 NAND 驻留）；控制器 DRAM 恒 37–50MB；逻辑写吞吐提升 1.1–3.5x、物理写最多降 85%，达不可行页级 FTL oracle 吞吐的 91–99%。

为什么值得看 首个 ZNS 存内去重架构，用 append-only 契约化解 FTL 与 DRAM 两大障碍。

item.title: LLM-Assisted Verilog Code Refinement for Efficient RTL Clock Gating
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

RTL clock gating is a popular technique for reducing clock power at the early design stage. Iterative updates of Verilog code, clock-gating inference, and analysis of clock-gating efficiency (CGE) are time-consuming and pose challenges to RTL designers. LLM-assisted automatic refinement of Verilog code for improving CGE is proposed. Since CGE and power depend on switching activity, LLMs generate Idle, Typical, and Peak workloads of the design, one of which is selected by the user as the optimization target. Four LLM clock-gating agents, each given a guideline for a particular clock-gating technique, then sequentially refine the Verilog code, focusing on the registers with low flop-gating efficiency (FGE) under the selected workload. Code updates are accepted only if they are functionally equivalent and reduce post-synthesis power without violating area and timing constraints. Experimental results with five RTL designs show an average FGE improvement of 12.1 percentage points and an average power reduction of 23.6% (up to 59.3%) under the selected workloads, compared to the original Verilog code, outperforming a commercial tool and an LLM baseline, which achieve average power reduct…

item.title: LLM-Assisted Co-Optimization of RTL and Synthesis Algorithms via Bottleneck Analysis
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Post-synthesis power, performance, and area (PPA) depend jointly on the register-transfer-level (RTL) code and the synthesis algorithms. However, the benefits of RTL optimization may be limited by bottlenecks in synthesis algorithms, and vice versa, leaving opportunities for better PPA unexplored by methods that optimize either level alone. In this work, we present a large language model (LLM)-assisted framework for regional co-optimization of RTL and synthesis algorithms via bottleneck analysis. A key insight behind our approach is that RTL structures and the Boolean networks used in synthesis expose complementary opportunities for addressing bottlenecks that lead to suboptimal PPA in different regions of the circuit. Our bottleneck analysis uses a Gaussian process (GP) to assess whether optimizing RTL or synthesis algorithms is more promising for each region. The GP learns from regional graph representations and PPA feedback. Using the GP's predictions and predictive uncertainty, Bayesian optimization (BO) provides guidance that an LLM Router combines with circuit analysis to choose how to address each region's bottlenecks. item.description:

研究问题 光子加速器做 ML 推理节能，但在紧内存、精度与硬件约束下让多个边缘客户端私有化大模型仍困难。

方法 LIELLA 权重流架构：多个边缘客户端通过紧凑私有适配器个性化共享模型；两种光子适配器架构分别支持反向传播与前向-only 优化；在模拟硬件噪声下评估。

为什么值得看 光子 PEFT 的私有边缘适配路线，硬件驱动的更小更有效适配器方向。

item.title: Hybrid state-space and attention neural operators for nonlinear structural dynamics under environmental loading
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

The computational burden of repeated nonlinear time-history analyses limits their application for structural assessment and design. We therefore propose DeepOJamba, a hybrid neural operator that combines selective state-space recurrence with full attention to predict the structural response history due to dynamic loading. Physical-parameter conditioning and predicted-state transfer between sequences enable a single trained operator to represent varying system conditions and generate response histories beyond its training sequence length. DeepOJamba is evaluated on a 15~MW monopile offshore wind turbine under wind and wave loading. The proposed operator is compared to pure attention, pure state-space, Fourier, and DeepONet operators and is found to give the lowest window error on every channel and the lowest closed-loop fatigue and ultimate-load errors of $9.4\%$ and $6.0\%$, against $14.6\%$ and $8.7\%$ for the next-best pure attention operator examined. Moreover, on sea states outside the training wave band, the error slightly increases by approximately $0.4$ percentage points. Pure state-space operators can approach similar low errors only with a much wider convolution kernel tun…

item.title: HKD-ACPA: Heterogeneous Knowledge Distillation Adversarial Cyber-Physical Attacks in Power Grids
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Learning-based algorithms assist power-grid control centers in localizing transmission-line attacks, yet existing adversarial attacks typically require white-box access or repeated online queries. We study a practical zero-query setting in which an adversary coordinates physical, denial-of-service (DoS), and false data injection (FDI) attacks using only local measurements and historical detector outputs. To bridge the input-view asymmetry between local adversarial observations and DoS-masked control-center measurements, we propose Heterogeneous Knowledge Distillation Adversarial Cyber-Physical Attacks (HKD-ACPA). HKD-ACPA distills historical detector predictions into a heterogeneous graph surrogate ensemble and trains a residual calibration module to correct the view-induced logit discrepancy. Over this calibrated surrogate, we formulate sparse, magnitude-bounded FDI synthesis with a group-balanced objective that jointly induces missed detections and false alarms, and solve the resulting hybrid discrete--continuous problem via bi-level projected gradient-based proximal policy optimization (PGPPO). Experiments on the IEEE 30-bus and 118-bus systems show that HKD-ACPA outperforms all…

item.title: Gossamer: A Utility-Driven Architecture for Constant-Budget KV Cache Compression in Reasoning LLMs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 推理 LLM 上下文延伸至数十万 token，KV 缓存主导内存与带宽；量化与驱逐等现有压缩方法纯算法层面，常引入额外 pass 与计算开销。

方法 Gossamer 提出效用驱动的 KV 压缩架构，在常量缓存预算下动态选择量化、合并或驱逐；把余弦相似度估计直接融合进 attention 计算（Free-Lunch Utilization），利用空闲计算周期做相似度评估，零延迟零带宽成本。

关键数字 紧内存约束下保持与未压缩推理相当的推理质量；端到端吞吐较未压缩基线最高 16.7x、较量化基 Oaken/Ecco 5.5x/4.9x、较驱逐基 R-KV 1.8x。

为什么值得看 算法-系统-硬件协同的常量预算 KV 压缩，注意力内免费算相似度。

item.title: Exact on Paper: Which LLM Serving Shortcuts Flip Graded Answers, Measured Against the Noise of Reordering the Same Requests
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 团队凭基准准确率不变就启用前缀缓存、分块 prefill、投机解码等"精确"服务特性，但准确率是聚合指标，特性可能翻转哪些请求被答对。

方法 vLLM 中服务一个 4B 指令模型：9 种单特性配置 + 参考配置 5 副本，逐次评分 5 个基准共 3,380 个请求；每个候选与重启下限（新进程）和调度下限（同请求不同顺序）对比。

关键数字 默认 kernel 下各配置准确率差在一分内，7 个精确特性翻转 1.47%（95% CI 1.13–1.85）至 1.78%（1.39–2.20）请求的评分结果，均不高于调度下限 1.72%；FP8 KV 缓存翻转 3.36%（2.80–3.96）；batch-invariant kernel 下 7 个特性逐请求复现参考文本，FP8 KV 仍翻转 3.91%（3.28–4.53）。

为什么值得看 量化"精确"特性的逐请求翻转率，建议在 batch-invariant kernel 或 ≥3 副本调度下限下认证服务变更。

item.title: CrysLDM: Latent Diffusion Model for Crystal Material Generation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Generating new crystal materials with desirable chemical properties has long been a challenging task. Existing diffusion models operate in feature space, requiring complex diffusion architectures to model the joint distribution of atom types, coordinates, and lattice structures. This complexity increases the number of diffusion steps, leading to higher training and sampling costs. In this work, we aim to generate novel crystal materials within a time- and resource-constrained setup, where existing models are not well-suited. To address this, we propose CrysLDM, a novel latent diffusion model for 3D crystal materials, which integrates a variational autoencoder and a diffusion model. The VAE encoder maps 3D crystal structures into a latent space, where the diffusion model operates. Since CrysLDM leverages a smooth, lower-dimensional latent space, it simplifies the generative process and accelerates both training and inference. Through extensive experiments on benchmark datasets and tasks, we show that CrysLDM generates stable and valid materials with quality comparable to state-of-the-art methods, while being significantly more efficient in terms of computational resources and time.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Constrained Diffusion from Binary Evaluations via Learned Doob h-Functions
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Conditional generation under constraints that can only be checked on a finished sample, such as a molecular property filter, remains challenging for diffusion models: most guidance methods require differentiable measurement operators, paired conditional data, or rollouts of the base model at every step. We present a framework grounded in the Doob $h$-transform that reduces conditional generation to learning a single function, the probability that a noisy sample denoises into the constraint set. We learn this function from binary clean-sample evaluations alone, by squared-error regression on forward-noised labels; the base model is frozen, one lightweight head is trained per constraint, and noisy-state classifier guidance arises as a special case. The exact guidance step fades where the constraint signal provably vanishes and carries a factor of the inverse probability across samples, which normalized guidance discards: with the schedule and mean step size held fixed, equalizing the step costs 17.0 to 18.5 points of constraint satisfaction on CIFAR-10 at comparable FID, across independently trained estimators. Guidance is more than 50$\times$ cheaper per satisfying sample than rejec…

item.title: Cache the Knowledge, Not Just the Prompt: Dynamic Datalog as the Action Language for LLM Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

An LLM agent that answers questions about a knowledge graph writes a program per question, and its tools evaluate each from scratch. We give the agent a Datalog REPL, a session over a dynamic Datalog engine, in which rules are inserted and retracted like facts while derived facts stay current. Prompt caching reuses the model's processing of what a session shares, and the Datalog REPL reuses the evaluation of it. On chains of questions over three knowledge graphs, agents reuse a relation that the REPL keeps in 179 of 180 cases, with two models, and write fewer output tokens: SQL and Python agents write 23 to 82% more. With SQL tables or a Python namespace, Claude Haiku 5.5 stores almost nothing for later questions, and a chain of seven questions at 13 million facts takes it a median of 48 and 56 s, against 31 s with the REPL. Claude Opus 5.5 matches the REPL by storing tables in SQL, and when the data changes it stores views, which are evaluated again at every read. A relation that the REPL keeps is read like a table and stays current like a view. Datalog is a niche language beside SQL and Python, and with thinking enabled the models answer as accurately with it.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: CXL Coherence Writes Back What Surviving Hosts See, Leaving Flushes Only for Ordering
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 CXL 共享内存的主机会缓存其行，崩溃主机丢失已修改未写回的行；现有设计要么停掉所有主机、假设存储能量、要么每次操作后冲刷。

方法 证明崩溃主机的客户端同死时，所需冲刷只是让一行不先于其依赖行到达存储设备的那些（保序冲刷），而非持久化冲刷——CXL 要求修改行在另一主机访问前写回，故幸存主机所见已上设备；对三个已发表设计的模型小实例测试。

关键数字 锁表无需冲刷即可保住幸存主机的锁；持久化哈希索引在两种负载下写入设备行数少于已发表代码的一半；分配器对每个新引用的冲刷对幸存者安全既非充分也非必要。

为什么值得看 把 CXL 崩溃一致性从持久化冲刷收紧为保序冲刷，有证明有实测。

item.title: Beyond Accuracy: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Hypothesis-Driven Experiment Planning in LLM Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Evaluating large language model (LLM) agents on scientific tasks typically reduces to final-task accuracy, which obscures where reasoning succeeds or breaks down. We introduce a benchmark and diagnostic evaluation framework for hypothesis-driven adaptive experimental planning in closed-world system identification, instantiated in kinetic mechanism identification. The framework goes beyond final accuracy in two ways. First, we evaluate exploration behavior by quantifying the extent to which agents exhibit space-filling or corner-seeking patterns in the experimental design space. Second, we decompose the reasoning process into four interpretable steps: belief update, hypothesis discrimination, discriminative experiment design, and predictive reasoning under interventions, each scored separately on reasoning traces. Across ten LLM agents, we find that stronger agents outperform both adaptive (Bayesian optimization) and non-adaptive (Latin hypercube) baselines and exhibit exploration patterns inconsistent with naive heuristics. item.title: BenchMint: From Real-World Tasks to Executable Benchmarks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Large language models (LLMs) need evaluations of everyday reasoning and tool use, such as planning itineraries under user constraints and grounding numerical answers in evidence. We introduce BenchMint, an automated benchmark-construction workflow, and Daily-Life, its collection of 100 selected tasks across 11 real-world domains. BenchMint jointly constructs tasks and scoring criteria from the same source documents. Language-model judges assess possible answers against these criteria using tool traces and private evidence. We report 26 model/harness configurations, including GPT, Claude and Gemini families; 17 have complete domain profiles. These are descriptive configuration results, not a controlled model ranking. In one selected travel task, we corrected the reference total from 320 to 380 minutes while keeping both answers unchanged. The incorrect answer's arithmetic verdict switched from pass to fail; the correct answer's switched from fail to pass. With one ballot per cell, this exposes a reference error without establishing repeatability or collection-wide validity. Incomplete construction comparisons establish no general advantage of joint authoring or feedback-guided revis…

item.title: BQDNA: Multi-Head Binary Spherical Quantization for Genomic Sequence Modeling
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Decoding biological information from long, repetitive DNA remains challenging. Genomic language models (gLMs) often follow the conventional language-model pretrain-and-adapt paradigm. However, the lack of inherent semantic segmentation and prior rules makes hand-crafted tokenizers like k-mer and BPE suboptimal. We introduce context-aware \textbf{BQVAE} for scalar quantization of DNA and \textbf{BQDNA}, an autoregressive gLM supporting multi-head codebooks. Comprehensive experiments reveal that: (1) unique training dynamics of vector quantization in DNA space, including the importance of alignment between training corpus and downstream data. (2) superior performance of BQVAE over hand-crafted tokenizers and vanilla VQVAE. (3) remarkable cross-species generalization capability of BQDNA, which achieves state-of-the-art performance with merely 0.1B multi-species training for BQVAE and 1 epoch training on hg38 for BQDNA, outperforming gLMs pretrained with 10$\sim$100x more tokens. Our findings underscore the potential of learned vector quantization for genomic sequence representation. Code is available at https://github.com/Sophie10001b/BQDNA

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Aggregation Dispersion: An Information-Geometric Diagnostic of Oversmoothing in Graph Neural Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Message-passing neural networks (MPNNs) learn node representations by iteratively aggregating information from neighbors, but stacking too many layers causes all representations to converge, an effect known as oversmoothing. We propose a geometric perspective on this phenomenon. At each depth $k$, the propagation operator assigns to every node $v$ a walk distribution $p_v^{(k)}$, a probability distribution over source nodes. These walk distributions form a point cloud on the probability simplex, whose contraction to a single point characterizes complete mixing of the propagation operator, and thus oversmoothing. To measure this contraction, we use the Fisher-Rao metric, the unique Riemannian metric on the simplex invariant up to scale under sufficient statistics, whose scaled chordal distance under the square-root embedding $p \mapsto \sqrt{p}$ is the Hellinger distance. The resulting diagnostic, the aggregation dispersion $D_k$, is the variance of the embedded point cloud on the unit sphere. We prove that: (i) $D_k = 0$ if and only if the $k$-th step propagation matrix has rank one, a necessary and sufficient condition for complete operator mixing; (ii) $D_k$ is non-increasing wit…

item.title: Adaptation or Poisoning? Security Risks of Conversational Test-Time Learning in Large Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Test-time learning (TTL) enables large language models to adapt to unlabeled inputs during deployment. The model updates a lightweight adapter by minimizing the next-token prediction loss on the input it receives. When these updates persist across conversation turns, every user query serves both as the request answered in the current turn and as adaptation data for later turns. By choosing the queries used for adaptation, an attacker can influence parameter updates and weaken safety alignment through ordinary interactions with a TTL chat service. To demonstrate this risk, we introduce Progressive Test-Time Adaptation Poisoning (P-TAP), a query-only multi-turn attack that jailbreaks the model by poisoning its session adapter through the service's own updates. A sequence of escalating adversarial queries shapes the adapter turn by turn; the final harmful request is then answered under the accumulated state without itself being used for adaptation. Across four open-weight instruction-tuned models, enabling updates raises attack success rates on average by 13.00 percentage points under greedy decoding and by 22.25 points under best-of-10 sampling, relative to matched sessions receiving…

item.title: ARC: Adaptive Rollout Control for Efficient Synchronous LLM Reinforcement Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 同步 LLM RL 走 rollout-屏障-更新循环，每次更新要等固定数量的完整组相对样本，但响应长度与奖励结果差异大且生成中才显现；静态准入与无条件完成让加速器空闲、浪费无效采样。

方法 ARC 闭环 rollout 架构，组粒度治理：校准流式回填从部分观测判断组是否值得完成、不值得立即回填新候选；延迟组完成把不确定的早停先搁置再恢复（恢复循环上限保证终止）；自适应准入与流水线按早期测量时长排序、仅在预期供给不足时准入新候选。

关键数字 rollout 时间降 37.4%（1.60x 加速），有效 GRPO 吞吐较基线提升 50.1%；直接恢复最终本应保留训练组的 98.9%。

为什么值得看 组粒度的同步 RL rollout 治理，直接提升 RL 训练加速器利用效率。

item.title: When to Test, Repair, or Regenerate: Decision-Guided Efficient RTL Generation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF

Large language models (LLMs) can generate register-transfer-level (RTL) designs from natural-language specifications. To improve functional correctness, many RTL agents use simulation feedback to guide refinement. However, without a reference testbench, generating one for every initial implementation incurs inference cost even when the RTL is correct. We therefore introduce an adaptive harness that uses a specialized decision model to orchestrate testing, refinement, and candidate selection. It accepts high-scoring initial implementations and generates testbenches for the rest. When further search is needed, the initial score guides repair--regeneration allocation, while defect rankings and simulation feedback guide repair. For final selection, the harness prioritizes test-passing candidates and ranks them using decision-model scores. Across three benchmarks, the harness with DeepSeek improves mean Pass@1 by 5.4--7.1 percentage points over initial implementations and reduces aggregate estimated inference cost by 11.0--14.3% relative to a testbench-guided repair baseline with the same candidate cap.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: When a Permitted Action Completes a Forbidden Workflow: Designing Consequence-Oriented Approval for LLM Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF

Tool-using language-model agents increasingly ask people to approve consequential actions, yet an approval prompt shows only the next step. A request to send a file to an approved recipient can look harmless even when that file was assembled, several steps earlier, from data the user said must never leave. We call this a cumulative authorization failure and argue that it is an interaction design problem as much as a security problem. The evidence a reviewer needs is spread across the trajectory, and listing it in time order leaves the reviewer to reconstruct the causal chain. We present the Cumulative Consent Ledger (CCL), an approval interface built on four design principles that restate the user's intent, bind the review to the exact action, compose the cumulative consequence, and keep every claim checkable. A trusted monitor that tracks artifact lineage supplies the evidence. In a between-subjects study with 80 participants and 960 approval decisions, CCL was associated with fewer unsafe approvals than an evidence-matched chronological log (24.2% vs. 32.5%), higher comprehension, and faster decisions, although the adjusted difference in unsafe approvals remained uncertain (-7.9 …

item.title: The Complexity of Oracle-Efficient Realizable Transductive Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF

In realizable transductive online learning, the learner knows the entire sequence of $T$ instances in advance, and the labels are consistent with one of $N$ hypotheses. With explicit access to the hypothesis class, the halving algorithm makes at most $\log_2 N$ mistakes. Can a comparable guarantee be achieved using only polynomially many empirical risk minimization (ERM) queries? We answer this question negatively, even for a weighted-ERM oracle that optimizes arbitrary real-valued linear objectives and returns a complete maximizing hypothesis. For every fixed $β\in(0,1)$ and every randomized learner making polynomially many oracle queries, there exists a fixed realizable instance with exactly $N=2^{\lfloor T^β\rfloor}$ hypotheses on which the learner makes $Ω_β(\sqrt{T\log N})$ mistakes in expectation. This matches the agnostic-rate upper bound achieved by random playout using $O(T)$ oracle calls. The separation persists for much smaller classes as well: along a sequence with $\log N=Θ((\log T)^2)$, we establish a mistake lower bound of $\exp(Ω(\log T/\log\log T))$. Our main technical contribution is a composition lemma that combines two realizable prediction problems such that th…

item.title: Synthetic EHR Generators Should Be Audited Like LLMs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF

Synthetic electronic health record (EHR) generation is increasingly adopting large autoregressive models, yet privacy evaluation has not kept pace, relying heavily on similarity-based heuristics and aggregate metrics that can obscure patient-specific memorisation. We argue that these models should additionally undergo LLM-style memorisation audits at the level of individual patient records. We support this position by comparing membership-inference evaluations across four prominent autoregressive EHR generators, highlighting inconsistent evaluation practices in patient representations and attack procedures. We evaluate trajectory reconstruction from partial context and introduce randomly assigned patient-level canaries to distinguish memorised associations from clinical generalisation. We examine these methods in a GPT-2-style model deliberately overfit to 1,000 MIMIC-IV patient trajectories, creating a controlled setting in which memorisation should be readily detectable. The model systematically recovers training patients' canaries, and their trajectory reconstruction approaches perfect accuracy with increasing context. item.title: Stein Guidance without Gradients: Discretization Uniform Diffusion Inference Time Scaling beyond Particle SMC
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF

Reward-guided diffusion requires effective steering and correction of the bias introduced by approximate value functions. A Brownian example shows that SMC with full multinomial resampling at every step can require particle counts to grow linearly with guidance depth to maintain accuracy. We propose Stein Guidance, which combines derivative-free guidance with whole-path independence Metropolis-Hastings correction. Value-weighted selection from centered Gaussian candidates approximates gradient guidance in expectation, using as few as two queries per step. Centering stabilizes the local normalizer estimates, and the same queries yield an explicit path weight for correction. Under uniform value and spatial regularity bounds, we prove superpolynomial decay of finite-grid total variation error in the number of MH updates, with constants that do not grow with guidance depth. The error prefactor tends to zero as the value functions approach exact Doob values and the time grid is refined.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: SAFE-DRIFT: Data Selection for Supervised Fine-tuning with Controllable Off-Target Drifts
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF

We propose SAFE-DRIFT, a data-selection framework for supervised fine-tuning that improves a target capability while controlling unwanted drift in the model's other behaviors. We formalize this as a constrained optimization problem that maximizes alignment with the target gradient, subject to a budget on off-target drift which we quantify using the Fisher information of a reference distribution. Under this objective, the optimal, closed-form update is a damped natural-gradient step that downweights reference-sensitive directions. To estimate these high-dimensional gradients and work within the right geometry, we further derive a scalable algorithm that approximates the Fisher information and the target gradient in a shared low-dimensional subspace and analyze how entanglement of the target and reference task can affect the update. We evaluate SAFE-DRIFT against state-of-the-art data selection methods across diverse domains including coding and medical question answering, yielding competitive target performance while reducing degradation on specified off-target behaviors.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: S$^2$LMR: Supervised Sequential Long-Context Multi-Step Retriever
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF

Multi-step retrieval over long contexts is a key capability for retrieval-augmented generation, but strong existing approaches are costly and complex to train. Supervised retrievers are far simpler and cheaper, yet they fall well behind in this setting. We show that this gap stems not from supervised training itself, but from three misalignments between training and inference: easy training negatives, noisy retrieval prefixes, and position-agnostic scoring. Guided by this analysis, we introduce S$^2$LMR, a simple yet effective supervised sequential retriever that models multi-step retrieval as the evolution of an explicit textual state encoded by a single shared Transformer. On long-context reasoning, multi-hop QA, and needle-in-a-haystack benchmarks with context lengths ranging from 4K to 10M tokens, S$^2$LMR achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art methods, substantially outperforming prior supervised retrievers. Notably, it requires only $\sim$2 hours of training on a single A6000 for contexts of up to 10M tokens, while remaining robust across a wide range of hyperparameter settings.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Reverse Seam-Carving: Structured Whitespace Preconditioning for Fixed-Die P&R
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF

At high placement utilization, limited whitespace increases cell displacement during legalization and clock tree synthesis (CTS), degrading routed wirelength. Existing P&R methodologies use uniform density targets or reactive whitespace redistribution, without optimizing whitespace structure before placement. We propose Reverse Seam-Carving (RSC), a pre-placement methodology that redistributes whitespace into core-spanning low-density seams between denser regions, while preserving die area and utilization. We further develop SeamGain, a semi-analytical model that selects the RSC configuration from a single reference run of the uniform flow; one SeamGain-selected run obtains 86% of the best-of-sweep wirelength reduction. In the OpenROAD flow with ASAP7, RSC achieves (maximum, average) post-route wirelength reductions of (27.6%, 15.4%).

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: RadAG: Reward-Adversarial Attention Guidance for Efficient Inference-Time Alignment of Diffusion Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF

Diffusion and flow-based models have achieved remarkable success in generation, yet their samples often remain suboptimal in fidelity and text alignment. Two lines of inference-time methods address this: extrapolation guidance, such as classifier-free guidance (CFG) and its variants, and reward guidance, which aligns samples with reward models of human preference. Extrapolation guidance needs only forward passes, but it builds its reference by heuristic rules unrelated to the reward and therefore cannot steer sampling toward a given reward. Gradient-based reward guidance steers sampling directly toward a higher reward, but backpropagates through the entire generator at every step. This trade-off raises the question of whether extrapolation guidance can steer sampling toward a higher reward without a full backward pass. To answer this, we introduce Reward-Adversarial Attention Guidance (RadAG), which constructs the reference by perturbing the attention logits of a single block against their reward gradient and extrapolates away from it. We prove that this update increases the reward of the clean estimate to first order, while its backward pass stops at the perturbed block instead of…

item.title: Pretraining Representation Lottery Determines Fine-tuning Generalization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF

Large scale pretraining (PT) followed by fine-tuning (FT) is the central paradigm of modern deep learning, yet how PT shapes FT generalization remains poorly understood. We use a synthetic setup in which the ground-truth concept geometry of entities is known, as a controlled testbed to study how representational geometry affects model behavior and how PT representations determine FT generalization. We first show that models differing only in training seed can closely match in PT loss yet vary substantially in FT generalization. We hypothesize that a representational lottery underlies this phenomenon: the random seed dependent geometry formed during PT determines what FT can reach. We confirm this causally. First, injecting the ground-truth concept geometry into the model yields near-ceiling FT generalization, showing that good representations directly drive generalization. Then, distilling a lucky seed's learned representation into an unlucky seed unlocks FT generalization, while distilling the same model's behavior does not. Furthermore, representation distillation can merge entities that never interacted during PT, which FT alone cannot. Finally, we show that regularizing represe…

item.title: Pixel Auto-Encoder: Reconstructing Language Model Activations Through Pixel Art
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF

Interpreting the high-dimensional internal representations of large language models (LLMs) remains a challenging problem. Recent approaches have explored translating these representations into human-understandable forms, particularly natural language. In this work, we explore the use of images as an alternative target modality for interpreting LLM activations. As a first step toward this goal, we introduce Pixel Auto-Encoder, which converts intermediate LLM activations into $32 \times 32$, 32-color pixel art and reconstructs them for subsequent computation within the model. By encouraging the intermediate representations to resemble predefined concept images, we investigate whether LLM activations can be expressed visually while preserving the model's language capabilities. We find that the model can produce target-aligned images for some concepts, and that replacing pixel representations with concept images can influence next-token predictions. However, we also observe a trade-off between visual alignment and language-model performance, as well as sensitivity to pixel-level changes that are difficult to interpret visually. These findings demonstrate the feasibility and limitations…

item.title: Physical regime changes expose formula misuse in large language models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF

Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly employed for scientific computing across the Earth and environmental sciences, but problems in these fields often involve distinct physical regimes. LLMs may fail to recognize these regime-dependent constraints, applying formulas outside their domains of validity and producing plausible but physically incorrect results. We systematically investigate these failures through controlled experiments and assess whether post-training can improve regime-aware reasoning. Across 72 physical mechanisms, we find frontier LLMs frequently misapply formulas outside their regimes of validity, reducing accuracy by 13-57 percentage points. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards enables Qwen3.5-9B to match DeepSeek V4 Flash (284B) on regime-dependent tasks, but its effectiveness is limited by the formulas available in the base model. Combining supervised fine-tuning on a few worked examples with reinforcement learning improves accuracy by 61 percentage points, while distillation from a teacher supplied with the correct formula raises accuracy from 0% to 71%.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: PAMS: Preconditioned Activation-Metric Subspace for Zeroth-Order LLM Fine-tuning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF

Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization provides a computationally efficient approach to fine-tuning large language models (LLMs), but conventional methods typically rely on isotropic perturbations that ignore the anisotropic structure of neural-network parameter spaces. We introduce Preconditioned Activation-Metric Subspace (PAMS), a ZO optimization framework that uses forward-pass activation statistics to construct structured, layer-wise perturbation geometries without computing gradients or forming dense curvature matrices. PAMS tracks a low-rank approximation of the dominant activation subspace and its associated spectrum online, and uses the spectrum to softly reweight perturbation variance while preserving exploration in directions outside the retained subspace. A trace normalization separates the perturbation geometry from its overall scale, enabling consistent perturbation magnitudes across layers. We show theoretically that the resulting perturbation covariance induces right-side preconditioning of the gradient of the corresponding Gaussian-smoothed objective. item.title: One Million Tokens in 20GB: Calibration-Free 2-Bit SRFT KV-Cache Compression for Looped MoE Inference on Apple Silicon
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 统一内存边缘设备的长上下文推理由 KV 缓存容量与内存带宽主导；32GB Apple M6 Mac mini 上 26.4B 循环 MoE 模型 Inkling-2-Mini 在 oMLX 中 64K token 即耗尽内存。

方法 利用混合 NoPE 架构三个结构性质（有界滑动窗口、1,024 token 带状相对偏置尾部恒零、unit-RMS 值归一化）+ 正交子采样随机傅里叶变换（SRFT），对 8 个全局访问的远前缀做免校准 2.000-bit Value / 2.125-bit Key Lloyd-Max 压缩，与精确 bf16 局部窗口在线 log-sum-exp 合并；自定义 GQA 打包 Metal 解码 kernel。

关键数字 有效 2.0625 bit/坐标，比 bf16 小 7.76x；73.4 GB/s；256K 下 17.09 tok/s（bf16 的 3.36x）、512K 13.81 tok/s、1,048,576 token 9.52 tok/s、峰值 19.49 GiB（KV 仅 4.37 GiB）；WikiText-2 上 3.06-bit SRFT 无损（ΔPPL −0.007），2.06-bit +0.130 且 8K/16K/32K 精确 7 位 passkey 检索 100%（3/3）。

为什么值得看 苹果芯片百万 token 边缘推理的免校准压缩方案，数字链路完整可核。

item.title: Multi-Order Passive Macromodeling from Layouts via Nested Port-Hamiltonian Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF

Compact, passive state-space macromodels of interconnects and power-delivery networks are essential for stable transient signal- and power-integrity simulations. However, conventional flows require costly per-layout full-wave electromagnetic (EM) simulations, while both traditional fitting and prior learning surrogates rely on post-hoc fitting or passivity perturbation that degrades accuracy without guaranteeing convergence. In this work, we propose an end-to-end macromodeling framework that learns directly in the passive space, mapping physical layout graphs to multi-order port-Hamiltonian (pH) macromodels. Specifically, our network encodes each layout graph into unconstrained matrix blocks and assembles them via a complete, prefix-nested pH parameterization that guarantees continuous-frequency passivity and stability by construction, yielding valid $k$-state macromodels via direct state slicing in one forward pass. To train all orders without reference realizations, we supervise the network directly on S-parameters through a progressive order-growth curriculum. item.title: Mirror Descent at the Edge of Stability
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF

In many deep learning settings, gradient descent has been shown to operate at the edge of stability -- a regime where the largest eigenvalue of the loss Hessian hovers around $2/η$. We study this phenomenon in mirror descent, a generalization of gradient descent. As mirror descent is non-Euclidean, existing explanations of the edge of stability phase do not extend to this setting. We generalize the existing notion of sharpness to introduce mirror sharpness, which measures the curvature of the loss with respect to the mirror potential. Empirically, we observe that the mirror sharpness hovers slightly above the $2/η$ threshold. Furthermore, we derive a dual central flow ODE for mirror descent that models iterates in continuous time at the onset of edge of stability. Our ODE provides insights into the difficulties of extending existing arguments for why sharpness stabilizes at $2/η$ from gradient descent to mirror descent in full generality.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

阅读原文 ↗
item.content:encoded:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF

In many deep learning settings, gradient descent has been shown to operate at the edge of stability -- a regime where the largest eigenvalue of the loss Hessian hovers around $2/η$. We study this phenomenon in mirror descent, a generalization of gradient descent. As mirror descent is non-Euclidean, existing explanations of the edge of stability phase do not extend to this setting. We generalize the existing notion of sharpness to introduce mirror sharpness, which measures the curvature of the loss with respect to the mirror potential. Empirically, we observe that the mirror sharpness hovers slightly above the $2/η$ threshold. Furthermore, we derive a dual central flow ODE for mirror descent that models iterates in continuous time at the onset of edge of stability. Our ODE provides insights into the difficulties of extending existing arguments for why sharpness stabilizes at $2/η$ from gradient descent to mirror descent in full generality.

item.title: Making Repeated Variational Circuit Optimization Efficient on GPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF

Repeated numerical optimization is a defining workload for classical simulation of parameterized quantum circuits. Although successive training steps change gate parameters, they usually preserve circuit connectivity and reuse a small set of gate-layer patterns. We use this regularity to accelerate gradient evaluation on GPUs. Our framework combines execution primitives for common circuit layers with adjoint differentiation, coordinating state evolution and derivative computation to reduce launch overhead, intermediate storage, and state-vector traffic. Because effective schedules depend on circuit size, gate structure, and device resources, our framework retains several execution choices instead of committing to a single schedule. Structural and hardware constraints narrow these choices, after which measurements on representative layers guide plan selection. The selected plans are reused while circuit structure remains fixed, spreading the selection cost over repeated training iterations. This approach targets the computation required by optimization rather than forward simulation alone, while retaining the numerical semantics of state-vector differentiation. Experiments across mu…

item.title: Joint Client Scheduling and Resource Allocation for Optimal Federated Learning over Wireless Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF

Federated learning often relies on partial client participation because full participation is costly in cross-device wireless systems with limited uplink resources, heterogeneous channel conditions, energy constraints, and strict upload deadlines. However, partial participation introduces sampling variance, causing the sampled update to deviate from the full-participation update. Existing optimal client sampling methods reduce this variance but usually rely on simplified client-count budgets, while wireless-aware scheduling methods account for communication constraints but do not directly optimize sampling variance. This paper proposes resource-aware optimal client sampling (RAOCS), a unified variance-minimizing client scheduling framework under uplink resource-block, round deadline, update-information, and energy constraints. The resulting problem admits a capped water-filling solution that balances client update importance, wireless resource cost, and energy feasibility. Experimental results demonstrate that RAOCS achieves accuracy comparable to that of OCS while reducing the average upload time per iteration by more than a factor of 252.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Interpreting Diffusion Model Activations in Natural Language
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF

Interpreting the intermediate activations of diffusion models (DMs) is key to understanding how they generate images. Existing interpretability methods for DMs provide limited support for open-ended interrogation, making it difficult to extract human-interpretable insights. We extend LatentQA, the task of answering natural-language questions about Large Language Model activations, to DM activations. We introduce the Diffusion-specific Activation Oracle (DAO), which translates DM activations into natural-language answers to open-ended questions about the ongoing generation. Our experiments show that DAO can effectively describe the content of the final image from activations at early denoising steps. Additionally, we demonstrate that DAO captures the structure of the DM's activation space well enough to steer image generation toward target attributes. Furthermore, we show that attribution patching through DAO identifies DM components that contribute to visual attributes specified in natural language. Our code is available \href{https://github.com/yamanoko/dao/tree/main}{here}.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Interaction Retention and Output-Likelihood Training in Parallel Sampling
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF

Parallel samplers such as masked diffusion language models generate several coordinates per step from conditional marginals and randomize which coordinates are generated together, so even exact conditionals return a distorted distribution. We give an exact local account of this distortion. Around any full-support product law, the Gram operator of the sampler's response is diagonal in the interaction decomposition, and its eigenvalues are retention probabilities: the probability that an interaction has a unique latest-revealed coordinate. This retention spectrum determines the exact frontier between output accuracy and conditional calibration, its regularization path, and the population response of finite-mixture likelihood training. For pairwise interactions it yields a sharp dichotomy. Under homogeneous retention, output-likelihood training is equivalent to a single context gain; heterogeneous retention opens correction directions beyond any scalar, with an advantage bounded by an explicit heterogeneity gap. On binarized digits and MNIST, output-likelihood training within a heterogeneous schedule library lowers calibrated test negative log-likelihood in all twelve paired compariso…

item.title: IndexerStage: Staging Indexer-K across Memory Tiers for Sparse-Attention LLM Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 长上下文稀疏注意力服务在注意力数据卸载后仍受 GPU 显存限制；DeepSeek Sparse Attention 的 Indexer-K 状态每层每解码步全量扫描，且逐步增长。

方法 IndexerStage 把 Indexer-K 状态外置到内存层级，保留原生 GPU score/top-k/attention kernel：完成页经共享执行缓冲分期、新条目本地保留；联合内存-传输准入检查在接收增长批前核对存储与各层传输需求；SGLang 实现，16 服务 + 16 后备 H800 GPU。

关键数字 16K–64K 输入下本地流式存储每服务 GPU 仅 0.65–0.70 GiB；较主机内存版 HiSparse 批增 12.28–23.08%、解码 TPS 1.08–1.14x；64K 固定 latent-KV 路径下 1.10x；混合长度动态服务平均批增 12.07%、1.31x 解码 TPS。

为什么值得看 为 DeepSeek Sparse Attention 的 Indexer 状态提供分层卸载运行时，工程实现完整可复现。

item.title: Hidden Sensitivity in LLM Pre-training: A Dynamic System View
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF

In Large Language Model (LLM) pre-training, loss curves can conceal substantial instability, i.e., even small perturbations may lead to dramatically different predictions while leaving loss nearly unchanged. To investigate this phenomenon and reveal the underlying mechanisms, we first formulate LLM pre-training as a non-autonomous dynamical system that jointly evolves model weights and Adam optimizer states. Based on this formulation, we introduce a normalized sensitivity score in optimizer-relative coordinates to identify sensitive training checkpoints. At one such checkpoint, a weight perturbation of only 10^(-5) leads to 35.7% disagreement in top-1 predictions and 16.2% disagreement in benchmark answers after 200 training steps, with only 0.8% of greedy generations remaining identical despite similar validation losses. Furthermore, we find that perturbations to Adam's first and second moments induce comparably large effects, with similar sensitivity patterns observed in OLMo-1B. Finally, guided by our diagnostic, targeted stabilization reduces top-1 disagreement to 0.83% and increases generation exact match to 88.3%, at the cost of a 0.11-nat increase in validation loss. item.title: HiPerfCC-KVCache: Accelerating Confidential LLM Serving with Hierarchical KV Caching
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 分层 KV 缓存靠保留 GPU 外可复用状态减少重复 prefill，但 GPU 机密计算（CC）下受保护的传输可能抹掉收益。

方法 表征 Hopper/Blackwell 上批量 KV 拷贝在长时间 CPU 侧处理期间持有驱动锁、阻塞独立服务的机制；据此设计 HiPerfCC-KVCache：管理资源生命周期、有界备份提交间优先就绪 token 回读、辅助上下文共享 GPU staging 并行 KV 恢复；在 SGLang 中实现，不改硬件与驱动。

关键数字 H200 最高负载下输出 token 吞吐几何平均 1.74x（最高 2.72x），首 token 延迟平均降 36%、最高 59%；RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 上几何平均 1.28x（最高 2.20x）。

为什么值得看 机密 LLM 服务场景的分层 KV 缓存，定量揭示驱动锁与传输并行瓶颈。

item.title: HiPPO Functional Memory: Coordinate-Queryable Attention for Irregular Time Series
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF

Irregular time series are recorded at nonuniform times and are often queried at other times: between observations, after the last one, or on a regular grid. Continuous-time models answer such queries by integrating latent dynamics, and time-aware attention models answer them by revisiting the observation tokens. We introduce HiPPO Functional Memory (HiPPO-FM), an attention operator that writes an irregular history into a rank-M function space with explicit time coordinates. Masked self-attention first exchanges content among the observations; the updated values are then contracted against kernel-smoothed HiPPO-Legendre features and solved through a regularized Gram matrix, so the retained coefficients define a function that is read at any time through the same features. The write and read have the form of an interdomain sparse Gaussian-process mean: every readout lies in an M-dimensional reproducing-kernel subspace, and a pointwise bound separates the approximation error of this subspace from the error of the learned memory. Removing the functional memory from the encoder raises Spiral reconstruction RMSE 18-fold. The full model has the lowest error in 11 of 12 Spiral settings, the…
