item.title: HME-PFD: Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts Privileged Feature Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF

Knowledge distillation (KD) is widely used to transfer knowledge from large teacher models to smaller student models, facilitating efficient serving of machine learning systems. In the context of ads recommendation, privileged features distillation (PFD) extends KD by allowing the teacher model to leverage privileged features, i.e., features available only during training, to enhance distillation performance. However, in real-world scenarios, privileged features often have limited coverage and exhibit heterogeneous distributions, resulting in training examples of varying importance for distillation and model learning. We propose Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts Privileged Feature Distillation (HME-PFD), a novel approach that incorporates privileged features into the routing module of a Mixture-of-Experts-based student model. Our method introduces both hard-coded and learnable routing modules, enabling the student to dynamically determine expert assignment based on the availability and values of privileged features. This design allows the student model to better handle the heterogeneous data scenario, where privileged features are partially observed, by differentiating between high-…

item.title: Don't Train It, Write It: An AI Agent Writes New Capabilities into Language Model Weights
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF

We show that an AI agent can write new capabilities into a pretrained language model by adding gated attention heads and MLP neurons inside its existing layers, without backpropagation and without fitting any weight to the answers of task examples. It has a budget of 50 model passes and sees no validation or test instance. Composed in one model, its modules for six BIG-Bench Hard (BBH) subtasks raise the normalized BBH score of Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct from 19.95 to 41.05 (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct: at most 35.01) and that of Gemma-3-1B-it from 10.25 to 32.86. Against the unmodified model at the same precision, both composites leave the next-token distribution on 1,023,000 WikiText tokens unchanged (KL exactly 0), give identical answers on 15,845 items of five other Leaderboard tests and identical scores on the other 18 BBH subtasks. The agent also writes exact multiplication up to 20 digits, running the model only up to 6 (100.0% on the absent lengths of the sealed test in both models; a LoRA with the same budget: at most 2.1%). item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

方法 DisSparse 把 top-p（核）稀疏注意力端到端集成进 vLLM：块选择与调度关键路径解耦、双流流水线把选择延迟藏进层计算、单遍直方图 top-p kernel；另用 token 重定位 kernel 处理块内稀疏（固定大小块混入高/低重要 token 导致的预算膨胀）。

关键数字 稀疏分析（块选择）较 SOTA top-p 方法加速 1.17x–1.80x，精度损失可忽略；同内存预算下最大批比密集 vLLM 大最多 8x。

为什么值得看 解决 top-p 在生产服务系统落地的块分配确定性与 kernel 开销两大难题。

Memory-efficient Muon methods aim to reduce storage overhead while preserving strong performance, yet existing approaches compromise either convergence guarantees or practical efficiency. In this paper, we focus on subspace optimization for Muon, where the choice of subspace determines the gradient information retained for updating. To preserve dominant information while providing the coverage needed for stochastic convergence guarantees, we construct a principal-random subspace that combines leading singular directions of the stochastic gradient with random directions sampled from their orthogonal complement. Under a fixed rank budget, there is a trade-off between principal exploitation and complementary coverage, making rank allocation important for practical optimization. Our key observation is that the preferred balance shifts from principal-heavy early in training to random-heavy later. Motivated by this shift, we propose \dram, a memory-efficient Muon optimizer that reallocates principal and random ranks across stages while maintaining momentum and performing matrix-sign normalization entirely in the subspace. item.title: CLAIR: Consistent LLM Adaptation via Index-free Reprogramming
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF

Time-series forecasting with pretrained large language models (LLMs) uses contextualized patch representations, raising the question of how to align them. Matching patches at the same temporal position is natural, but self-attention allows each patch state to incorporate information from elsewhere in the input window, suggesting that useful correspondences can extend across positions. This flexibility, however, does not necessarily translate into consistent forecasts: similar patch states may play different roles when used in their original temporal order. To address both issues, we propose CLAIR (Consistent LLM Adaptation via Index-free Reprogramming), a teacher-guided framework that combines patch-level transport alignment (PTA) and forecast-level consistency (FC). A clean-view exponential moving average (EMA) teacher guides a mildly perturbed student, with PTA establishing soft, representation-dependent correspondences and FC encouraging agreement at corresponding future steps. The forecasting head retains the original patch order. We test this combination through controlled comparisons: while PTA and index-wise alignment perform similarly without FC, PTA+FC under EMA supervisio…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 显存受限 GPU 上 MoE 推理靠 expert 卸载，但 expert 传输与 CPU 执行拖慢解码；投机解码可缓解，独立草稿权重却占用稀缺显存、长草稿增加验证需求。

方法 CCAMoE 统一运行时，协调自适应投机解码与并发 expert 缓存更新：仅缓存草稿（复用驻留目标 expert 生成提案与路由提示，无独立草稿权重）、草稿引导缓存更新（预测 expert 需求、传输与计算重叠）、成本感知草稿长度控制。

关键数字 多种 MoE 模型、GPU 平台与负载下解码延迟一致最低，较 SOTA 基线最高 2.33x 加速。

item.title: BitShare: Sensitivity-Aware Binning and Bit Sharing for Compacting LLM Weight Storage
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 小批量 LLM 解码受内存带宽限制，每权重存储位数基本决定成本；组内量化把同组所有权重存为同一精度，但组内输入通道敏感度不同。

方法 BitShare 是无码本权重格式，保留整数网格与反量化器、组内变精度：敏感度感知分箱把每组通道放入三个固定位置箱；静态位共享让低敏感权重共享低位（每组或每对权重存一次）；共享感知版 GPTQ 免微调无码本选值。

关键数字 同存储下 3/2 bit 在 WikiText-2 与 C4 困惑度均低于 GPTQ；Llama-2/3 上 2-bit BITSHARE-N 较 SliM-LLM 困惑度最多降 70%、较 GPTAQ 降 35%；SliM-LLM 同等困惑度下每权重少存 13.6–19.4% 位；SkyWater 130nm 硬件解码器验证通过。

为什么值得看 免微调、无码本的组内变精度压缩，压缩率与硬件可实现性兼顾。

item.title: ArrythML-II: An Optimized TinyML Framework for ECG Arrhythmia Detection and Multi-Class Beat Classification on Wearable Devices
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 可穿戴设备上需在端侧做 ECG 心律失常检测与多分类，模型必须足够紧凑。

方法 ArrythML-II 系统化超参优化紧凑自编码器，自定义评分联合考虑检测性能、重建误差阈值与模型尺寸；扩展为六类心拍分类；INT8 量化后用 TensorFlow Lite Micro 部署到基于 PSoC 6 的自研单导联电池设备。

关键数字 自编码器约 44KB、分类器约 22KB，每段端到端 5.1ms / 4.7ms；MIT-BIH 库上自编码器准确率 84.76%、精确率 82.68%、召回 77.99%，分类器准确率 82.29%、加权精确率 90.18%；并用预载段、实时信号与 ESP32-S3 ECG 模拟器实测验证。

为什么值得看 完整的 TinyML 端到端落地（优化→量化→部署→实测），对可穿戴医疗硬件有直接参考。

item.title: AgriManager: A Framework and Benchmark for LLM-RL Generalization in Agricultural Management
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-21　分类：论文PDF

Agricultural management is heterogeneous along two axes. The first is distributional shift within a fixed task interface: weather, crops, and prices vary across years and locations while sensors, actions, and objective stay fixed. The second is structural shift across interfaces: different farms expose different observed variables, available actions, and management objectives. We formalize the second axis as schema shift: variation in the policy-facing schema $Σ= (Σ_O, Σ_A, Σ_R)$ between training and deployment. We test whether LLM-RL generalizes across both axes with AgriManager, to our knowledge the first framework that trains LLM policies with RL across multiple process-based crop simulators, unifying DSSAT, WOFOST, and Cycles. We design a three-tier generalization ladder: Tier 1 within-schema distributional shift, Tier 2 single-axis schema shift along $Σ_O / Σ_A / Σ_R$, Tier 3 compositional schema shift across simulators, all scored on a frozen held-out test suite with three training seeds per method. Within fixed schemas, Qwen3-4B trained by RL with explicit reasoning exceeds neural-network PPO trained with the same interaction budget; without reasoning, training stalls near n…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: WingBench: Benchmarking How AI Agents Search for Better Designs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

Design search often uses cheap learned predictions to choose which candidates deserve expensive tests, but these tests can fail, especially on the unusual designs that optimization favors. We introduce WingBench, a multifidelity benchmark in which optimizers and AI agents design transonic wings with computational fluid dynamics (CFD) inside the search. They can query a learned aerodynamic surrogate and spend a fixed budget of sequential CFD evaluations, each returning a score or a failure type. WingBench grades the design each method recommends, reporting separately whether it receives a valid score and how good that score is. Using WingBench, we contribute a study of five baseline optimizers and a comparison of three AI agent methods, which produced 6,629 CFD evaluation records. Feedback helps baseline optimizers deliver valid designs when it changes their later proposals, but the differential-evolution variant does so with lower aerodynamic quality. An open-ended research agent finds designs of similar quality to the strongest baselines over 32 CFD queries, with different prior information and unmatched total computation. In early search, our reflection and planning implementatio…

item.title: Which Loans, Not How Many: Exactly Level-Invariant, Anytime-Valid Monitoring of Deployed Risk Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

A refinancing wave can change the number of mortgage prepayments without changing the relationship between scores and prepayment. In a logistic model, conditioning on the monthly count removes the intercept from the likelihood of which loans prepay. Our fixed-start slope product tests a lower bound on the calibration slope. At threshold 20 its probability of ever crossing under the null is at most 5%. The restarted level sum tracks departures from intercept tolerance. A confidence sequence estimates a constant slope, and the restart-intersection rule detects changes in that slope. A continuous mixture avoids the off-grid width floor of a discrete prior. On Freddie Mac loans, fixed-slope resampling reproduces 78% of maintained-model monthly AUC variance in development and 70% in the holdout (95% intervals 57-100% and 48-100%). From fresh holdout starts, the restarted level sum crosses on both paths, and the fixed-start slope product stays below threshold on both. The restart-intersection rule signals a downward change for the frozen model in April 2018 and an upward change for the maintained model in a supplementary run in August 2019.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Weave: Routing-Adaptive Runtime Warp Scheduling for MoE Megakernels
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：专家并行（EP）下 SOTA 系统把每个 MoE 层融合成持久 megakernel；每 GPU 的通信与计算量随路由结果变化，但先前工作要么编译期固定资源划分（MegaMoE）、要么仅粗粒度 SM 级适应（mKernel 整 SM 做通信、Tensor Core 空闲）。

方法：Weave 三设计：空间调度在 SM 与 warp 两级分配通信/计算资源匹配负载；时间调度随执行切换 warp 角色（层始末全员参与、把输出 scatter 选择性交给空闲通信 warp）；融合成本模型启动时从运行时路由统计联合选择两种调度。

关键数字：EP8 下 MoE 层相对 DeepGEMM-MegaMoE 提速 1.30× geomean（SM103 最高 1.97×、SM90 最高 1.72×）；EP16 CDNA3 上比最快官方 RCCL+AITER 基线快 1.44× geomean（最高 2.87×，vLLM 为 1.67×）。

为什么值得看：MoE megakernel 的 warp 级运行时自适应，跨平台一致提速。

原文：Weave: Routing-Adaptive Runtime Warp Scheduling for MoE Megakernels

item.title: WEIR: Watershed Exploration and Drift-Aware Prefix Shrinkage for Multi-Turn Agent Reinforcement Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

WEIR：多轮 agent RL 的分水岭探索与前缀收缩

Multi-turn language model agents often receive only a single binary reward at the end of a long interaction trajectory, making it difficult to separate decisive decisions from routine steps or estimate accurate intermediate values. Prefix-tree methods improve sample efficiency by merging trajectories that share action histories, yet two structural flaws remain: naive pooling mixes stale off-policy outcomes into critic targets with fixed weights, and uniform or entropy-driven branching wastes continuations on dead-end states whose outcome is already settled. We introduce WEIR (Watershed Exploration and Intrinsic-Drift Shrinkage), an actor-critic reinforcement learning framework grounded in a Doob turn-variance conservation identity. WEIR maintains a cross-iteration canonical action-prefix tree with exponentially discounted visit counts and trains a prefix-conditioned critic toward a minimax drift-aware shrinkage target that adapts from single-trajectory returns at rare nodes to pooled empirical means at dense nodes. item.title: Verifying and Strengthening Neural Tangent Kernel Theory
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

Neural Tangent Kernel 理论的 Lean4 机器验证

Writing Neural tangent kernel (NTK) theory explains why very wide neural networks trained by gradient methods converge in the lazy-training regime. Its standard proof combines matrix concentration, random Gram matrices, continuous-time dynamics, spectral perturbation, and a bootstrap argument, but has lacked machine-checked verification. We present a Lean\~4 formalisation for two-layer networks, proving an end-to-end theorem: for a smooth bounded activation (instantiated with $σ=\tanh$), frozen biases, paired $\pm 1$ initialisation, and explicit width conditions, gradient flow exists uniquely with probability at least $1-δ$, and $$ \|r(t)\|^2 \leq \|y\|^2 e^{-λ_0 t/2}. $$ The sole data assumption is population NTK non-degeneracy, $λ_0>0$. Initial coercivity, kernel drift, the movement bootstrap, the residual ODE, and flow existence and uniqueness are formally proved. The formalisation also sharpens the standard analysis in two ways. First, replacing the conventional matrix-Bernstein variance proxy with the classical row-covariance proxy yields estimated concentration-width certificates for $\tanh$ that are $36$--$53\times$ smaller at $(m,d)=(16,8)$ and $94$--$121\times$ smaller at …

Writing Neural tangent kernel (NTK) theory explains why very wide neural networks trained by gradient methods converge in the lazy-training regime. Its standard proof combines matrix concentration, random Gram matrices, continuous-time dynamics, spectral perturbation, and a bootstrap argument, but has lacked machine-checked verification. We present a Lean\~4 formalisation for two-layer networks, proving an end-to-end theorem: for a smooth bounded activation (instantiated with $σ=\tanh$), frozen biases, paired $\pm 1$ initialisation, and explicit width conditions, gradient flow exists uniquely with probability at least $1-δ$, and $$ \|r(t)\|^2 \leq \|y\|^2 e^{-λ_0 t/2}. $$ The sole data assumption is population NTK non-degeneracy, $λ_0>0$. Initial coercivity, kernel drift, the movement bootstrap, the residual ODE, and flow existence and uniqueness are formally proved. The formalisation also sharpens the standard analysis in two ways. First, replacing the conventional matrix-Bernstein variance proxy with the classical row-covariance proxy yields estimated concentration-width certificates for $\tanh$ that are $36$--$53\times$ smaller at $(m,d)=(16,8)$ and $94$--$121\times$ smaller at …

item.title: Turnout: Adaptive Attention Switching for Efficient Reasoning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：事后 transformer 线性化用固定大小状态替代随生成长度线性增长的 KV cache，降内存但常损精度，长生成推理任务尤甚——能否保留内存收益同时减少精度损失？

方法：Turnout 对预训练全注意力模型应用事后线性化，经蒸馏训练线性路径、保留原全注意力路径不变；生成时混合模型双路径并存，用学到的策略控制每层何时从全注意力切换到线性注意力；策略经强化学习训练，奖励平衡答案正确性与内存使用。

关键数字：学到的自适应策略在推理任务上取得比固定切换与静态混合基线更好的准确率-效率 Pareto 前沿（详见原文）。

为什么值得看：线性化精度损失的策略化修复，同时保留内存收益。

item.title: Topology Hub Optimal Transport: Eliminating Long Context Dilution at Flash Speed
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：长上下文模型用稀疏/结构化注意力避免平方开销，但嵌入数十万干扰项中的少量相关事实会随归一化质量随长度分散而退化（dilution）。

方法：THOT：hub-and-spoke 最优传输用线性规模图（局部窗口 + K 共享 hub + Sinkhorn 缩放）替代稠密 L×L 矩阵；bounded-support capacity gating（simplex sparsemax O(L log L) 或免排序 thresholded ReLU O(L)）把多余干扰质量压到零；三趟退火 Sinkhorn 调度；精确 rank-(D+2R+1) One-Reference-Tile adjoint（Triton kernel，BF16 Tensor Core/FP32 potentials）；分块 exclusive-prefix 因果变体验证零未来泄漏。

关键数字：L=128 训练、L=262,144 零样本 recall 97.40%（α=0）、98.83%（α=0.05），而 softmax-gated hub OT 仅 3.52%；WikiText-103 多针检索 128/128 全中（L=65K）vs RoPE FlashAttention 0.78%。

为什么值得看：长上下文事实稀释的系统解法，极长序列检索性能惊艳。

原文：Topology Hub Optimal Transport: Eliminating Long Context Dilution at Flash Speed

item.title: The Vulnerability Window: Decision Instability in Quantized Reward Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：奖励模型与 LLM judge 常量化到 4bit 以摊薄打分成本，常规检查只看基准准确率「几乎不动」——该检查几乎失明：量化到底如何影响决策？

方法：跨 8 个奖励模型（两家族 0.6B~8B）、3 个生成式 judge、4 个 4-bit 量化器系统分析：量化重写逐对偏好决策、且修正与引入的错误相互抵消；高斯近似 Phi(-|m|/sigma) 描述聚合翻转率；把诊断定位到 margin 而非高斯分布。

关键数字：1.1~12.3% 逐对偏好决策被重写而聚合准确率仅动 0.03 点（p=1.00）；下游 14.6~65.7% 问题 best-of-64 选择改变（final answer 仅 2.6~9.6%）；margin 预测器 AUC 0.927。

为什么值得看：揭示「准确率不动」假象，为量化奖励模型提供真正的诊断指标。

原文：The Vulnerability Window: Decision Instability in Quantized Reward Models

item.title: TabK: Amortized Bayesian Estimation of the Number of Clusters in Tabular Data
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

Estimating the number of clusters, $k$, is a fundamental prerequisite for most clustering algorithms. Traditionally, this estimation has relied on computationally expensive grid searches over internal cluster validity indices (CVIs) or adaptive clustering algorithms, both constrained by specific statistical assumptions. We introduce TabK, a zero-shot, permutation-invariant transformer architecture that frames the estimation of $k$ as an amortized Bayesian inference problem for tabular data. TabK leverages a novel Quantile Feature Encoder (QFE) to extract position-free, content-derived representations from empirical marginal distributions. By learning a generalized structural bias over a diverse synthetic prior, TabK estimates the number of clusters in a single forward pass per ensemble member. Evaluated across 50 diverse real-world benchmarks, TabK outperforms all competing methods, achieving a mean absolute error (MAE) value of 1.04 compared to 2.14 for the closest competitor. TabK also achieves the lowest average inference time, producing estimates in less than one second on average and running $2\times$ faster than TabClustPFN and $30\times$ faster than traditional CVIs such as …

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: THRIFTY: Cost-Constrained Reasoning-Data Synthesis for Small Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：SLM 通常训练在从大 teacher LLM 蒸馏的推理轨迹上，合成数据生成是管线主要成本（前沿模型尤甚）；现有收集方法成本无意识，或把固定采样预算均匀摊到所有查询，忽略问题难度差异。

方法：THRIFTY Thompson 采样 bandit 控制器：把固定生成 token 预算花在期望得到最多新且不同正确解处（bandits-with-knapsacks + 多样性感知目标）；用在线 Beta 后验跟踪每题成功概率，自适应停止饱和问题、集中预算于覆盖不足者、按机会成本淘汰不可解者。

关键数字：数学（AIME、MATH-500）与代码（LiveCodeBench）上每 token 收集的多样正确轨迹比均匀采样与最强自适应基线最多多 22%，稀缺预算与难题场景增益最大。

为什么值得看：成本约束下推理数据合成的预算分配，SLM 训练管线直接省钱。

原文：THRIFTY: Cost-Constrained Reasoning-Data Synthesis for Small Language Models

item.title: Stratum: A Hardware-Software Co-Design Framework for SNN Inference on RISC-V
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：RISC-V 上高效 SNN 推理需把实现成本追溯到编译器与硬件决策，但训练环境、编译器、周期级模拟器各自独立、难以归因。

方法：Stratum 统一工作流：集成 snnTorch 训练的 SNN、MLIR 编译器栈与 gem5 周期级 RISC-V 模型；暴露两个优化杠杆（生成代码的软件决策、模拟核心的硬件配置），用阶段级周期测量定位性能瓶颈。

关键数字：两层 N-MNIST 网络上 spike-gated lowering 把模拟推理时间降 64×（453.2ms→7.04ms）；spike-major 布局在 4MiB L2 下再降 37.2%（到 4.42ms）；L2 缩到 1MiB 时布局加速从 1.59× 增至 1.88×。

为什么值得看：软硬件协同的 SNN 快速早期评估框架，成本归因清晰。

原文：Stratum: A Hardware-Software Co-Design Framework for SNN Inference on RISC-V

item.title: Solving the pre-image problem in kernel PCA: The reproducing property is all you need
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

核 PCA 预像问题：再生性质求解

Kernel PCA extends PCA to nonlinear dimensionality reduction by implicitly mapping data into a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) via the kernel trick, with applications ranging from image denoising to out-of-distribution detection. While its projection map is well understood, appropriately defining the associated reconstruction map is a longstanding challenge since projecting back from the RKHS to the input space is non-trivial. This is known as the pre-image problem. Existing approaches have tackled this problem by either relying on nonlinear optimization, which is prone to numerical instabilities and sensitive to initialization, or by solving a separate supervised learning problem, incurring additional computational overhead. Furthermore, although the projection map of kernel PCA reduces to that of standard PCA when a linear kernel is used, most of these approaches are not guaranteed to recover PCA's reconstruction map in this case, a consistency property that one would naturally expect to hold. In this paper, we leverage the reproducing property of the RKHS to derive a reconstruction map for kernel PCA that is provably consistent. Our derivations rely on the mild assumptio…

item.title: SONATI: Spatio-temporal ocean neighbourhood asymmetric transformer for imputation of sparse, tabular data with uncertainty
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

Missing value imputation is often a prerequisite for downstream analyses. In oceanography, observational data are frequently structured in a tabular manner, highly sparse and exhibit spatio-temporal structures that classical imputers such as k-nearest neighbours or MissForest are not suited to exploit. We present the Spatio-temporal Ocean Neighbourhood Asymmetric Transformer for Imputation (SONATI), a masked, factorised time-space transformer operating on pre-computed, local time and space neighbourhoods, which reduces computational complexity compared to global attention. SONATI is designed to work with tabular data and is thus in principle able to work on both gridded and unstructured data, though evaluation here was performed on gridded North Atlantic data only. It provides aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties through a negative log-likelihood loss and multiple forward passes with Monte Carlo dropout. Systematic ablations on attention type and masking strategies guided the final architecture design. The results showed that SONATI outperformed classical and transformer-based methods by at least 12.5% in terms of root mean squared error (RMSE) on a large observational oceanograph…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Rethinking ANNS on Commodity PIM: PIM-Native Vector Search with Cooperative Filtering
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：ANNS 的内存受限向量扫描阶段让 PIM 成为理想加速平台，但现有 PIM-ANNS 基本把 CPU 的距离评估与 top-k 选择移植到 PIM，引入与轻量 PIM 核心不匹配的算术/状态重操作。

方法：PIVOT：二元量化重铸 PIM 侧距离评估（利用 PIM 原生位运算、免 LUT、低算术成本）；阈值引导协作过滤（survivor-mass 模型推导保守阈值，做 CPU 簇过滤 + PIM 下界过滤，减输出流量、去 per-core top-k 状态）；配置专用 PIM kernel 并跨查询批流水 CPU 准备/重排与 PIM 过滤。

关键数字：真实 UPMEM 硬件上过滤 99.3~99.7% 探测向量；QPS 达 CPU 基线 18.8×、先前 PIM 基线 10.2×；recall 也高于现有 PIM 系统。

为什么值得看：PIM 上 ANNS 的原生重设计，效果在真实硬件验证。

原文：Rethinking ANNS on Commodity PIM: PIM-Native Vector Search with Cooperative Filtering

item.title: RefineKV: Query-Adaptive KV Cache Compression via Attention-Error Bounds
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 长上下文解码反复访问完整 KV 缓存是主要瓶颈；小查询特定子集即可近似全注意力，但这些子集的并集几乎覆盖整个缓存。

方法 RefineKV 把 KV 缓存分簇，误差可忽略的簇用紧凑代表、其余展开回原始 KV 条目；从注意力输出误差上界推导选择准则，揭示重要性（簇影响）与保真度（簇可被代表的程度）两个互补因子。

关键数字 两模型三基准上保持近全注意力质量；attention 阶段最高 7.6x 加速，整体解码 1.66x 加速，建立新的质量-延迟帕累托前沿。

为什么值得看 解码期查询自适应 KV 压缩，用理论误差界指导选择而非启发式。

item.title: Ranking-Preserving Coreset Selection for Efficient Evolutionary Hyperparameter Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

保持排序的核集选择加速进化超参优化

Hyperparameter optimization (HPO) is essential for high predictive performance, but its computational cost becomes prohibitive when candidate configurations require repeated training on large datasets. This paper proposes a ranking-preserving coreset (RPC) selection framework for accelerating evolutionary HPO. The method constructs a compact coreset that preserves the relative ranking of hyperparameter configurations observed on the full training data. Coreset selection is formulated as an evolutionary optimization problem that maximizes Spearman rank correlation between full-data and subset-based configuration rankings while penalizing subset size. The selected coreset is then used for HPO with three evolutionary algorithms: Genetic Algorithm (GA), Cross-generational elitist Selection, Heterogeneous Recombination and Cataclysmic Mutation (CHC), and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO). Experiments on seven tabular, two text, and two image benchmark datasets show that RPC substantially reduces HPO time while maintaining test accuracy comparable to full-dataset HPO across decision tree, text classification, and image classification tasks. Across datasets and optimizers, HPO-stage speed…

item.title: Preserving Pretrained CFG Structure in RL for Diffusion Models with Conditional Contrast Regularization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

扩散模型 RL 中保留预训练 CFG 结构的条件对比正则化

Reinforcement Learning (RL) has become an important component in the post-training of diffusion models. In practice, however, standard RL often improves the target reward without reliably preserving holistic generation quality, leading to unstable reward-quality trade-offs that we view as a form of reward hacking. Since Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) is known to improve visual clarity, prompt alignment, and perceptual quality in generation, we investigate whether its underlying structure can serve as a useful prior during RL. We present a unified geometric view that interprets both CFG and RL as correction vectors in a common prediction space, and identify the projection of the RL-induced correction onto the pretrained CFG correction as a useful diagnostic of quality-related structural preservation. Geometric analysis and rotation intervention further show that the pretrained CFG direction carries information useful for generation quality that reward-driven RL updates do not necessarily preserve. Based on this insight, we propose Conditional Contrast Regularization (CCR), which uses the frozen reference model's conditional contrast as a local structural prior during RL. Experiments…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Potential emergence in LLM agents: a statistical physics perspective
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

LLM agent 势涌现的统计物理视角

There has been significant recent interest in understanding the behaviour of LLM agents from the perspective of human preferences or corpus statistics. In this paper we propose agent states as intermediate variables through which post-training can be measured and predicted. From a statistical physics perspective, we study the emergence of a global potential which governs the transition of state in LLM agent reasoning. We introduce a partition function to model the ideal KL-regularised transition distribution and track potential structure, mean reward and state entropy. We demonstrate our approach in two Qwen3.5-9B tasks: safety-test selection and physics-reasoning auditing. We observe that the potential structure strengthens during post-training as predicted from our framework, while joint changes in reward and state entropy provide consistency evidence. States thus provide a quantitative description of how post-training organises agent behaviour.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: PRISM: Validation-Free Online Batch Selection for LLM Fine-Tuning via Preconditioned Conic Ghost Matching
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

PRISM：免验证在线批选择用于 LLM 微调

Online batch selection lowers the cost of fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) by replacing each candidate batch with a smaller informative subset. Existing selectors typically depend on a held-out validation or proxy set, or else rely on Euclidean facility-location objectives over unpreconditioned gradients whose diameter-shifted similarities are distorted by heavy-tailed gradient norms and cross-layer anisotropy. We introduce PRISM (Preconditioned Ray-Isotropic Submodular Matching), a validation-free online batch selector that aligns candidate gradients in a factored second-moment metric and casts subset construction as conic facility location over positive ray projections. Computing the required pairwise geometry through factored preconditioned ghost inner products avoids materializing per-example parameter gradients, while the conic objective remains normalized, nonnegative, and monotone submodular---guaranteeing a $(1-1/e)$ greedy approximation whose additive error scales with total batch gradient energy rather than the worst-case outlier diameter. Assigning each candidate to its best-aligned selected ray induces closed-form radial projection weights that automatically shr…

item.title: PLoQ: A Prompt-Specific Low-Rank Basis for 4-bit Quantization of LLM Activations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：低比特激活量化难在少数主导方向决定量化范围；SOTA 方法离线校准后把变换折进权重、对所有 prompt 固定同一子空间，每个 prompt 的独特方向不受保护。

方法：PLoQ prompt 自适应低秩分解：量化前提取主导激活分量、单独量化、在层内 GEMM 中恢复且不改权重；低秩基在 prefill 时从每个 prompt 估计、解码全程复用。

关键数字：同 bit 宽（激活平均约 4.2 bit）下在 1B~70B 六个 Llama/Qwen 模型上全部胜过 SOTA 混合精度量化，最高恢复 SOTA 仍损失的困惑度的 46%；Llama-3.1-8B 8k token 仅增 4% prefill、8% 解码开销。

为什么值得看：激活量化的 prompt 自适应路线，模型规模覆盖全。

原文：PLoQ: A Prompt-Specific Low-Rank Basis for 4-bit Quantization of LLM Activations

item.title: Online Learning for Minimizing Maximum Tardiness in Single-Machine Scheduling
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

单机调度最小化最大迟到时间的在线学习

We study online learning for minimizing maximum tardiness (\OMMT) in single-machine scheduling. In each round, the learner selects a permutation of \(n\) fixed jobs, representing a schedule. The environment then reveals a processing time and a due date for each job, and the learner incurs a vector-valued loss whose components correspond to the tardiness of the individual jobs. The goal of the learner is to minimize \(α\)-regret, the difference between the learner's maximum cumulative tardiness and \(α\) times that of the best fixed permutation in hindsight, for as small \(α\) as possible. We investigate OMMT under both stochastic and adversarial environments. In the stochastic setting, we prove that the expected \(1\)-regret of the Follow-the-Leader (FTL) algorithm is \( O\!\left(\frac{n\log n}{Δ^2}\right) \), together with a corresponding high-probability bound, where \(Δ\) is a distribution-dependent gap parameter. At round \(t \in \{1,\dots,T\}\), FTL runs in \(O(tn^2)\) time and \(O(tn)\) space. In the adversarial setting, we prove that, for any \(0<c<\log_2 n/16\), the \(α\)-regret is \(Ω(T)\) whenever \(α<\log_2 n/16-c\). We then reduce OMMT to a surrogate online learning pro…

item.title: ORION: Exact Canonical-State Supervision for Systematic Generalization in Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

ORION：精确规范状态监督提升 Transformer 系统泛化

Autoregressive Transformers generally fail on out-of-distribution reasoning due to two primary reasons: positional corruption over long sequences and structural state drift across deep execution steps. We introduce ORION, a framework that supervises exact canonical execution states via auxiliary heads to anchor latent trajectories to valid computational manifolds. Across Folding, GridShift, and CLRS-30, a pre-registered 2 x 2 factorial shows that RoPE and ORION address orthogonal axes. RoPE recovers length extrapolation (59.8%), while ORION recovers depth extrapolation (66.7%). Moreover, their combination complementarily achieves strict additive gain in joint length-depth extrapolation, while either method alone offers near satisfactory results. Negative controls confirm that the gain depends strictly on exact canonical alignment; hashed state statistics fail to constrain depth extrapolation.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Multi-Tier Edge Triage: Optimizing Latency for Safe Clinical Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

Multi-Tier Edge Triage：临床 agent 安全分流延迟优化

Deploying generative AI agents in enterprise clinical workflows requires enforcing multi-dimensional safety and compliance policies--preventing HIPAA Protected Health Information (PHI) exposure, maintaining clinical scope-of-practice boundaries, ensuring patient-appropriate reading comprehension, and preserving brand integrity--under interactive latency constraints. Synchronous outbound calls to cloud Large Language Model (LLM) judges add substantial network and decoding overhead onto the critical response path. We present Multi-Tier Edge Triage, a safety screening architecture that co-locates a compact Tier-1 sequence classifier on the clinical agent's host server, resolving clear queries in-process without a network round-trip and escalating only ambiguous queries to a Tier-2 cloud LLM judge. To evaluate Tier-1 encoders without length or unigram shortcuts, we construct four length-matched contrastive twin benchmarks seeded from MedSafetyBench, ASQ-PHI, and a synthetic four-mandate clinical assistant policy (Generic HealthCorp). While frozen local encoders match cloud models on structured PHI detection (>= 98.3% accuracy in <= 23.5 ms), they degrade markedly on semantic safety and…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Model Carving: Training Transformers That Optimize Their Own Topology
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：经典 Transformer 每层固定训练相同顺序的注意力与 MLP 子层——架构选择与训练长期分离，这种均匀性是惯例而非原则性设计；最优架构可能更小、更高效且远非均匀。

方法：Model Carving 单次运行同时学习 Transformer 的权重与架构：对每个子层加可学习标量门，让训练损失在训练中移除模型自身组件，释放内部更小的异构网络。

关键数字：140M~2.7B 标准与 140M~1.3B looped Transformer 上，同训练算力下雕刻模型的验证损失低于用多至 1.7× 算力训练的稠密模型；FLOPs 每 token 最多省 34%、解码最多快 1.6×。

为什么值得看：把「训练中雕刻架构」落地的系统工作，边缘小模型的新路线。

原文：Model Carving: Training Transformers That Optimize Their Own Topology

item.title: Mind the Delta: Early Pruning of RTL Variants for Agentic Hardware Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

Mind the Delta：agentic RTL 优化中变体早期剪枝，缓解综合评估计算不对称

Autonomous coding agents powered by large language models (LLMs) now write diverse microarchitectural variants of existing register-transfer level (RTL) designs at high throughput, shifting the primary bottleneck of agentic RTL optimization onto logic synthesis. Commercial toolchains take hours per variant, creating an acute compute asymmetry between proposing and evaluating variants. Existing fast evaluators falter in this regime. Subtle RTL edits trigger nonlinear synthesis shifts that learned predictors and coding agents cannot resolve, while synthesis proxies at reduced effort either alter the optimization trajectory or retain most of its runtime. Selecting a variant, however, does not require regressing absolute quality of results across designs, only identifying when a candidate cannot surpass the best completed feasible implementation. Based on the observation that synthesis trajectories share strong design-specific bias with their base design, we propose DiffScope, a training-free anytime selection framework that races full synthesis runs in parallel. By pairing live area telemetry with the already synthesized base trajectory, DiffScope cancels early mapping inflation, redu…

item.title: LingSante-Pulse: Unified Physiological Pretraining through Random-Feature Prediction and Cross-Modal Alignment
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

LingSante-Pulse：统一生理信号预训练框架

Clinical monitoring and wearable devices capture complementary physiological signals, but their partially overlapping modality coverage makes within-signal information and cross-modal relationships difficult to exploit jointly. We introduce LingSante-Pulse, a unified, general-purpose and flexible physiological representation framework that learns from these heterogeneous recordings. A shared, signal-conditioned encoder processes each physical channel independently and supports different numbers and combinations of signals for multimodal assessment and single-sensor inference. Pairwise cross-modal alignment, structured random-feature prediction (RFP) and masked waveform reconstruction jointly learn physiological relationships and preserve informative within-signal structure. Across 38 general physiological task configurations spanning PPG, ECG, EEG and EMG, the frozen encoder achieves the best dataset-balanced mean rank in each domain. In sleep assessment, multimodal staging on the HMC dataset and EEG-only staging on the Sleep-EDF dataset reach Macro-F1 scores of 0.7784 and 0.7941, respectively, while single-lead ECG apnea screening achieves an AUROC of 0.9183. item.title: Learning When to Ask: Advisor-Aware Post-Training for SLM Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：小语言模型（SLM）便宜、高吞吐，但长程任务所需的多步推理与工具使用较弱；如何后训练 SLM 在适当时刻向更强模型求助、并自己执行建议（advisor-executor 模式）？

方法：ADAPT 多阶段后训练配方：完全从策略自身 rollout 学习、以环境结果监督，无需奖励模型或人工标注；教会模型成本感知地决定何时问、以及如何跨步骤遵循建议。

关键数字：TextWorld 成功率 24.5%→77.3%、LiveCodeBench 21.8%→56.0%、GAIA 17.5%→49.3%，每任务仅约 1.0~2.1 次咨询；长程域收窄到 oracle 差距的 70~85%；换未见过的 advisor 增益保持。

为什么值得看：低成本 SLM agent 的实用提升配方，跨域数据充分。

原文：Learning When to Ask: Advisor-Aware Post-Training for SLM Agents

item.title: Large Reported CHB-MIT Adaptation Gains Disappear with Pretrained Encoders and Matched Probes
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

CHB-MIT 癫痫检测适配增益在预训练编码器下消失的复现研究

Dani and Liebe (2026) (DL) report that adapting the final encoder block of BIOT and CBraMod with self-supervised learning (SSL) improves CHB-MIT seizure-detection ROC-AUC by 36.2 and 29.5 points over linear probing. We investigate these results with their released code and an independent pipeline. The release loads pretrained weights for adaptation only when an otherwise unset configuration key is supplied, and its CBraMod probe reads the reconstruction head with dropout active. With pretrained initialisation and a probe on the encoder output in evaluation mode, the fixed-recipe adaptation gain on DL's split is -0.6 points for BIOT (95% interval [-3.8, +2.6]) and +0.01 for CBraMod ([-0.02, +0.04]) across five seeds. Across DL's split and five subject rotations on CHB-MIT and Siena Scalp EEG, with equally tuned linear probes (30 configurations, up to 500 epochs, validation-based early stopping), mean adaptation effects range from -1.1 to +5.7 ROC-AUC points over 18 comparisons (related settings and feature variants). Twelve of 18 support equivalence within +/-3 points under dependence-adjusted inference (8 of 12 rotation and 4 of 6 fixed-split comparisons); six are unresolved. After…

item.title: Joint SLA Admission and Risk Allocation for Cloud Resource Provisioning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

云资源供给中 SLA 接纳与风险分配的联合决策

Cloud controllers must reserve enough CPU and memory to meet demand without leaving too much capacity idle. Under a shared service-level agreement (SLA), a shortage of CPU or memory (considered as resource) counts toward the same limit. Dividing the allowed shortage risk between them changes how much extra capacity each need. We study this choice when forecast-error histories are short or correlated over time. Our controller compares different approaches to split the allowed shortage risk between resources. For each split, the controller uses historical forecast errors to determine how much extra capacity to reserve. It checks whether the history is enough to support that split and its consistency across different parts of the history. Among the splits that pass, it chooses the one with the lowest combined cost of shortages and idle capacity. Otherwise, the controller continues serving the workload with a calibrated fallback. In our simulation, we set a joint SLA target of sufficient CPU and memory in at least 95% of time slots and used 192 hours of historical forecast errors to structure the controller. Compared with always using fallback, the controller reduced the time slots all…

item.title: Isonomy: Isolating Every Request from Timing Side Channels at Nearly Full-Sharing Throughput in Multi-Instance LLM Prefill
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：长 prompt 共享前缀、复用缓存可省 prefill 计算，但 cache hit 让首 token 更早到达、可泄露另一请求用了同一前缀；最小权限下即便有权发送付费请求也不应暴露同账号其他请求的 prompt。

方法：Isonomy 默认隔离每个请求、允许显式共享组；跨账号保留一个共享缓存但只隐藏请求组外前缀的 hit；gateway 只对负载与可见缓存条目应用路由规则；预测模式估计首 token 就绪时间并门控释放，执行模式预留隐藏 hit 跳过的计算并用其他请求填充。

关键数字：饱和时预测模式保留无保护共享吞吐的 0.98（账号隔离为 0.95、跨账号复用多时 0.80）；2/4/8 实例直接探测测试两种模式都把探测优势上界保持在测量噪声内。

为什么值得看：安全与吞吐兼顾的多实例 prefill 隔离，agent 与 reseller 场景直接相关。

原文：Isonomy: Isolating Every Request from Timing Side Channels at Nearly Full-Sharing Throughput in Multi-Instance LLM Prefill

item.title: IsoMoE: Placement-Invariant Hybrid CPU-GPU MoE Inference with Lossless 12-bit Experts
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：混合 CPU-GPU MoE 推理把部分专家卸载到 CPU 以单 GPU 跑更大模型；专家放置随 GPU 空闲内存变化、应只影响速度，但现有混合引擎的贪心解码输出随放置改变（两设备算术不同）；且解码受 CPU 内存带宽限制。

方法：IsoMoE 保证输出与专家放置无关：GPU expert kernel 逐位重放 CPU kernel 的算术；内存布局让 CPU 用 AVX-512 点积指令高效计算无损 12-bit 专家；双 micro-batch 流水重叠 CPU/GPU 计算且不改输出。

关键数字：三种 MoE 模型上不同放置下输出逐位一致；每个设置都快于最强基线，平均解码加速 1.26×、最高 1.54×。

为什么值得看：可复现性（bitwise 一致）与速度兼得的混合推理系统，代码开源。

原文：IsoMoE: Placement-Invariant Hybrid CPU-GPU MoE Inference with Lossless 12-bit Experts

item.title: Improved Accuracy Scaling with Problem Complexity in LLM Arithmetic Reasoning Using Executable Symbolic Representations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

可执行符号表示改善 LLM 算术推理的复杂度扩展

High accuracy on mathematical benchmarks does not establish whether reasoning remains reliable as problem complexity increases. We examine how executable symbolic representations change accuracy scaling in large language models compared with natural-language reasoning. To address this limitation, we introduce the GSM Arithmetic Benchmark (GSM-AB), a controlled benchmark that independently varies operand digit length and operation count to probe numerical scale and compositional complexity. We find that executable representations can improve accuracy and slow its decline as complexity increases. Lean reduces average sensitivity to operand digit length at every tested model size. By contrast, slower degradation with increasing operation count emerges at the larger model sizes. A Python program-of-thought (Python-PoT) control shows a similar operation-axis pattern, suggesting that this finding is not specific to Lean. These findings show that reasoning representation shapes arithmetic accuracy scaling and support executable symbolic representations for more reliable reasoning on complex arithmetic tasks.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Improved (Minimum) Spanning Tree Construction in the HYBRID Model
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

HYBRID 模型中改进的(最小)生成树构造

In the HYBRID$_0$ model, vertices exchange $O(\log n)$-bit messages in synchronous rounds, both along input edges (local communication) and directly to vertices whose IDs they know (global communication). The local capacity is the maximum number of messages a vertex may send per round to each input neighbor, and the global capacity is the maximum number of global messages it may send, and also receive, per round. The standard capacity is local capacity $O(1)$ and global capacity $O(\log n)$. A well-formed tree (WFT) is a virtual tree of maximum degree $O(1)$ and diameter $O(\log n)$. Known algorithms construct a spanning tree (ST) and a WFT either in $O(\log n)$ rounds with global capacity $O(\log^2 n)$ or with standard capacity in $O(\log^2 n)$ rounds. We give a randomized algorithm that constructs an ST and a WFT in every connected component of any graph in $O(\log n)$ rounds with high probability under standard capacity. Our approach is based on a $Δ$-pseudo-spanning representation ($Δ$-PSR): a virtual network of maximum degree $Δ$ with restoration information, such that any spanning tree of this network can be restored to a spanning tree of the input graph in $O(\log n)$ rounds…

item.title: Graph Signal Generation via Graph-Aware Diffusion Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

图感知扩散模型的图信号生成

Many signals are defined on the nodes of a graph, such as traffic flow at road sensors or user purchases of related products. They are often partly observed, and learning their distribution enables imputing missing values and forecasting future ones. Diffusion models learn such distributions, but their forward noise is independent across nodes and does not depend on the graph. We introduce graph-aware diffusion (GAD), whose forward process is a heat diffusion on the graph driven by Gaussian noise. In the graph Fourier basis, the forward transition is a scalar Gaussian channel at each frequency. With a shared diffusion rate, high graph frequencies are attenuated faster than low ones. We propose Mode-Adaptive SNR Scheduling (MASS), which assigns each graph frequency its own diffusion rate and keeps all of them at the same SNR. For graph-stationary signals, MASS equalizes the normalized error of the optimal linear denoiser across frequencies. We bound reverse-SDE stiffness as a function of the (shifted) Laplacian's condition number, with a logarithmic upper bound for MASS and a linear lower bound for shared rates. GAD with MASS improves recommendation accuracy by 5-19%, reduces traffi…

item.title: GRADPlace: Geometry-Based Routing-Augmented Differentiable Placement for Routability Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

GRADPlace：几何路由增强的可微布局，用于布线优化

Routability-driven placement needs gradients that show how cell movement redistributes routing demand. Cell inflation exploits routing feedback only indirectly, and differentiable methods rely on black-box congestion predictors or on virtual-cell congestion fields frozen between routing updates. We present GRADPlace, which represents probability-weighted candidate routes as movable horizontal and vertical segments. Routing feedback sets their probabilities, while their geometry and expected demand evolve with cell coordinates. An electrostatic routing objective propagates gradients through this geometry to connected cells, complementing cell inflation. On the ISPD 2015 benchmarks, our reproduced Xplace-route and published DCGP results have on average 3.37x and 2.56x as many design-rule violations as GRADPlace, with more vias and comparable routed wirelength.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: From Gist to Verbatim: The Controllable Path of One Image Through a Diffusion Prior
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

扩散先验中单图像的 gist 到 verbatim 可控路径

Modern generative models are typically studied for their ability to generalize, while memorization is treated as a failure mode. We invert this perspective and ask how a generative model can recall a single datum. We frame memorization as a control problem: a learned conditioning signal steers a frozen diffusion model toward a target image, and we follow the formation of this memory throughout training. Before converging to exact reproduction (verbatim), memory passes through a regime of abstraction: samples preserve the target's semantic content (gist) while remaining diverse in appearance, leaving predictable detail to the generative prior. This semantic organization emerges despite the absence of labels, captions, or any explicit semantic objective. In the abstraction regime, the learned memory approaches ordinary text conditioning and supports editing, one-shot recognition, and retrieval more effectively than in the near-perfect reconstruction regime. These results suggest that memorization can serve as a probe of the relevance structure encoded by a generative model: what must be stored about a datum, what can be reconstructed from prior knowledge, and how learned memories int…

We frame memorization as a control problem: a learned conditioning signal steers a frozen diffusion model toward a target image, and we follow the formation of this memory throughout training. Before converging to exact reproduction (verbatim), memory passes through a regime of abstraction: samples preserve the target's semantic content (gist) while remaining diverse in appearance, leaving predictable detail to the generative prior. This semantic organization emerges despite the absence of labels, captions, or any explicit semantic objective. In the abstraction regime, the learned memory approaches ordinary text conditioning and supports editing, one-shot recognition, and retrieval more effectively than in the near-perfect reconstruction regime. These results suggest that memorization can serve as a probe of the relevance structure encoded by a generative model: what must be stored about a datum, what can be reconstructed from prior knowledge, and how learned memories int…

item.title: Feedback Shortcut: Speculative Decoding for Latent Feedback Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 潜在反馈 Transformer 把顶层隐状态反馈进下一位置输入以提升性能，但会破坏投机解码：验证草稿 token 需要前一位的顶层状态，草稿只能依赖近似替身。

方法 Feedback Shortcut 双管齐下：状态对齐训练轻量投影，把多 token 预测头状态映射为替身，不动基座训练；流水线校正用前驱新算出的状态重估草稿，并入后续草稿的验证 pass，零额外调用。

关键数字 135M/780M 规模下距精确解码上限保持 10⁻⁴ bits/byte 以内；解码加速 2.4–2.8x，训练算力仅多约 2%；大批量下跳过校正仍保持 Transformer 速度并保留潜在反馈增益的 80% 以上。

为什么值得看 在不降低精确解码性能上限的前提下恢复可投机性，方案轻量、训练开销极小。

item.title: Federated and Balanced $k$-means: Communication Efficiency, Privacy, and Heterogeneity
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

Fabric：联邦平衡 k-means，通信效率与隐私

Collaborating on data across organizations in healthcare and finance demands methods that preserve privacy while enabling effective analysis. Vertical Federated Learning (VFL) facilitates clustering across data where different parties hold different features of the same entities without sharing raw data. However, existing VFL clustering methods suffer from two key limitations: vulnerability to information leakage and the creation of imbalanced clusters. To address these limitations, we propose Fabric, a balanced and privacy-preserving federated $k$-means algorithm. Our method decomposes the balanced clustering problem into independent subproblems for each client, using the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) to efficiently handle the balance constraints. Under the semi-honest model, Fabric provides provable privacy guarantees by injecting calibrated noise into local objective evaluations. Extensive evaluations on ten real-world datasets show that Fabric achieves a superior utility-privacy trade-off compared with state-of-the-art methods and converges faster. item.title: Failure Modes and Data-Efficient Remedies for Transformer-Based Prediction of Viscoplastic Flows
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

Fast and accurate prediction of viscoplastic flows remains a challenge in computational rheology due to yield surfaces, discontinuous gradients, and strongly nonlinear transitions between yielded and unyielded regions. Transformer-based neural operators such as RheOFormer have recently shown strong potential for surrogate modeling of non-Newtonian flows. However, their applicability to viscoplastic systems and their efficacy in recovering realistic flows remain poorly understood. In this work, we present the first systematic investigation of RheOFormer applied to steady Bingham channel flow. By isolating the problem to a simple geometry and constitutive model, we examine how dataset structure, numerical value range, and input representation govern the model's ability to interpolate and extrapolate within the parameter space. The data regimes in which RheOFormer remains accurate and those in which errors emerge are identified, particularly for plug-dominated flows and for conditions outside the velocity scales or flow structures represented during training. item.title: FOREST: Coordinating Tree-based HBF, RRAM, and HBM for Efficient Speculative LLM Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：投机解码各阶段资源需求不同：目标验证要高通量访问大权重集、串行草稿在紧延迟下跑紧凑模型、长上下文注意力处理增长的 KV cache；GPU 中心 SD 用共享 HBM 中心内存与通用计算造成容量/带宽/计算错配。

方法：FOREST 异构内存中心架构协调 HBF、3D 堆叠 RRAM 与 HBM 三种存储计算树：计算对齐 3D RRAM 做低延迟草稿；跨树数值协同把块缩放 Q/K/V 预处理移到 HBF/RRAM 根板、在 HBM 树做 BFP 注意力；HBF 感知的设计空间探索揭示带宽-计算配给与模型规模的权衡。

关键数字：6 个 SD 配置（32B~405B 目标模型）上最高端到端 5.5× 加速、11.46× decode 吞吐、16.5× decode 能效（对比 A800 基线）；TCO 模型下 token 生成成本效率最高 6.73×。

为什么值得看：SD 从 GPU 中心转向内存中心的系统级重构，数字亮眼。

原文：FOREST: Coordinating Tree-based HBF, RRAM, and HBM for Efficient Speculative LLM Inference

item.title: Exploring the Potential of Ultra-Low-Bit Inference on LLM Accelerators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：向量量化（VQ）把数值组编码为紧凑码本索引实现超低比特压缩，但重建需频繁码本查找，与传统加速器数据流冲突——能否在现有脉动阵列加速器上高效做 VQ 推理？

方法：论证现有 systolic-array LLM 加速器已具备 VQ 推理所需硬件资源、只是缺乏利用机制；VQACC 联合重设计 operand buffer 的访问逻辑与数据映射，复用其存储与端口资源做码本查找，把反量化无缝集成进正常 operand 寻址数据流。

关键数字：比 EVA 基线快 2.63×，额外硬件仅占计算阵列面积 0.17%。

为什么值得看：极低硬件开销解锁 VQ 超低比特推理，无需 VQ 专用加速器。

原文：Exploring the Potential of Ultra-Low-Bit Inference on LLM Accelerators

item.title: Efficient VLA Reinforcement Learning via Subchunk Rollouts in Latent World Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

LS-MBPO：潜世界模型的高效 VLA RL

Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) can improve pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies through imagined experiences. However, existing VLA-MBRL methods primarily rely on large-scale image or video generation world models, incurring large computational overhead. Latent world models offer a more efficient alternative but face two challenges: compounding errors during recursive prediction and incompatibility with VLAs' visual input interfaces. In this work, we propose LS-MBPO, a lightweight residual MBRL framework that leverages latent world models to improve upon pretrained VLAs. LS-MBPO introduces two key techniques: (1) Hierarchical Forcing, which combines dense causal supervision with autoregressive feedback to mitigate compounding prediction errors; and (2) Latent Subchunk Rollouts, which leverage action chunks from a frozen VLA policy and a latent residual policy for successive subchunk refinement, bridging the gap between latent imagination and VLA policy execution. We further introduce a Progress-Conditioned Branch-Start Curriculum that progressively shifts rollout starting points from later to earlier task stages, enabling effective policy learning from short …

item.title: Dugong: Composing Uncertified DAG Consensus
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

Dugong：统一参数化的非认证 DAG 共识协议

There is a significant number of uncertified DAG consensus protocols spanning partial synchrony and asynchrony as well as crash, Byzantine, and hybrid fault models, yet each protocol is designed, proved, and implemented from scratch. We introduce Dugong, a single parameterized protocol that unifies uncertified DAG consensus protocols. Its core algorithm, the Decider can implement eight existing protocols and yields four new ones by just tuning its parameters. Given the property that DAGs decouple throughput from latency Dugong presents a simple trade-off between latency and resilience to network and node faults. An operator can adapt the parameters of their protocol epoch-by-epoch to adjust the resilience without needing to develop a new protocol or worry about throughput. Around the Decider, Dugong layers production feature mechanisms (adaptive leader scheduling, checkpoints, responsive liveness, and crash recovery) that provably compose with each other and with the Decider's configurations. We formalize Dugong in Lean 4, proving safety and liveness under the established definitions of Byzantine atomic broadcast, and identify and repair gaps in published proofs. Finally, we implem…

item.title: Drive Failure and Lifetime Simulation in the Backblaze Drive Statistics Corpus, 2013-2026
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

Backblaze 硬盘故障与寿命模拟（2013-2026 语料）

Storage simulators estimate data-loss risk from assumptions about drive lifetimes and dependence between failures. We test these assumptions against Backblaze's daily records from April 2013 to June 2026: 504,624 data drives with usable power-on ages, 99 drive models, 2.0 million drive-years and 31,881 recorded failures, including removals of drives judged likely to fail. We test failure-count forecasts over nine successive years and forecast the drives already in service at each prediction date. Accounting for drive-model differences and attributes improves the score assigned to observed failure counts about 4.3 times as much as replacing a single Weibull with two competing Weibulls under the same drive-model treatment. Fleet failure risk falls early and rises at older ages, but the fixed bathtub benchmark predicts 2.4 times the observed failures. Across 169 well-observed drive-model years selected using earlier records, 95% prediction intervals cover 44% of observed counts without annual variation and 92% with fleet-wide changes and shared good or bad years for each drive model. For drives already in service, a SMART warning raises one-year failure-risk ranking AUC from 0.64 to 0…

item.title: Distillation with Errors: Sparse Unbiased Backpropagation for Knowledge Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：知识蒸馏训练学生匹配教师输出分布，但全词表蒸馏需要昂贵的输出头反向传播——如何降低成本？

方法：DWE（Distillation with Errors）：关键洞察是小批量训练本就近似训练梯度、逐位置反向传播不必精确；利用 logit 梯度的零和结构构造稀疏配对梯度估计，期望与全词表梯度一致；几何感知配对 + 分层采样进一步降方差，并证明估计器无偏。

关键数字：同采样预算下 hidden-state 与输出权重梯度 MSE 比重要性采样降 63.5%/57.9%；off-policy 蒸馏输出头最高 1.95× 加速、训练时间降 10.4~15.7%；on-policy 最高 2.20×。

为什么值得看：蒸馏成本瓶颈的直接解法，无偏且代码开源。

原文：Distillation with Errors: Sparse Unbiased Backpropagation for Knowledge Distillation

item.title: DistDNA: Language Model Fingerprinting under Stochastic Decoding
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

DistDNA：随机解码下语言模型指纹识别

Behavioral fingerprints identify a large language model (LLM) from its responses to a shared set of prompts, enabling applications such as verifying whether a deployed model corresponds to the checkpoint it claims to be. Deployed models, however, are commonly served with stochastic decoding, under which the same model may produce different responses to an identical prompt, depending on an unknown temperature and top-$p$ setting. Existing representations such as LLM DNA provide limited treatment of this variation. A natural remedy is to characterize models by their response distributions, which, however, raises two challenges. First, each distribution must be estimated from only a small number of sampled responses. Second, a change in decoding setting can alter responses to the same extent as a change of checkpoint. Consequently, fingerprint distances alone provide an incomplete basis for model identity, and identification typically relies on a classifier trained jointly on fingerprints from many checkpoints. We propose DistDNA, which represents a model by its prompt-conditional response distributions and compares models by promptwise maximum mean discrepancy (MMD). The model under …

item.title: Degradation of Language Models under Controlled Load: Synchronization, Rule Execution and Misfires on the Background
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

受控负载下语言模型的退化：同步、规则执行与误触发

As the load grows, a language model makes more and more errors, but different processes stand behind this decline in quality. The model may lose the correspondence with the source text, it may keep its place in the text but execute a rule wrongly, or it may change a word that no rule concerns. In this work the degradation of a model under controlled load is separated into these three components: synchronization, rule execution and misfires. The load is set by rules that replace one word with another in a meaningless text, and each kind of load (the text length, the position of a word in the answer, the replacement density, the number of rules and the place of a rule in the list) is set separately. The alignment of the answer with the reference makes it possible to follow the outcome of every word, and a statistical model that takes into account that the spread of difficulty between requests itself depends on the load restores, for each component, the laws of its dependence on every kind of load. These laws make up the passport of a model. The paper presents the method of the separation, the principles of constructing the laws and the passports of seven models built by this method; …

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: DPMA: Learning to Compress Mixture-of-Experts Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：MoE 架构计算效率高，但存储全部专家需大量内存、限制资源受限硬件部署；现有免重训压缩方法大多只剪枝或只合并，且常用逐层统一压缩比。

方法：DPMA（可微剪枝-合并-吸收）：在全局专家预算下经梯度下降联合学习压缩操作与逐层专家分配；独立可学习系数支持剪枝专家、合并其参数、把路由贡献转发给保留专家；权重冻结、在校准数据上匹配原模型输出。

关键数字：4 个 MoE 模型、8 个多选题基准、5 个压缩比下平均准确率最高；75% 专家缩减时全面超过最强基线，最高 +6.7 个百分点。

为什么值得看：MoE 压缩从「剪或合」升级为联合学习，效果数据充分。

原文：DPMA: Learning to Compress Mixture-of-Experts Models

item.title: Cruella: A Unified Microscaling and Floating-Point Dot-Product Unit for LLM Inference on FPGAs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：加速器原生执行的数字格式制造时固定，而新 LLM checkpoint 用 MXFP4（MX 格式）；FPGA 可通过 bitstream 采用新格式，但尚无已部署的 FPGA LLM 加速器同时执行 MXFP4 权重与 BF16 乘积。

方法：Cruella 统一点积单元（UDPU）在同一 DSP 阵列与归约流水线上执行两种乘积：per-group 预对齐把流水保持在 BF16 宽度（困惑度变化最多 0.7%）；pre-adder 打包把一个 DSP48E2 乘法器放两个有符号 MXFP4×BF16 乘积并做精确校正。

关键数字：Alveo U55C 上比同等吞吐的分离单元省 23% DSP、36% LUT；MXFP4 权重解码比 BF16 快 1.15×~1.87×；A40 GPU 更快但每 token 能耗是板卡的 0.92×~2.01×。

为什么值得看：让 FPGA 原生执行 MX 格式 checkpoint 的统一单元，资源与能耗双省。

原文：Cruella: A Unified Microscaling and Floating-Point Dot-Product Unit for LLM Inference on FPGAs

item.title: Cross-Site Transformers Are Robust Heart Rate Estimators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

Single-site heart-rate estimation from photoplethysmography (PPG) degrades sharply under real-world motion. Multi-site PPG provides a natural solution, but existing models fuse sites as generic sensor channels rather than exploiting their hemodynamic structure: each heartbeat propagates along the arterial tree, appearing across body sites as delayed and transformed copies of the same cardiac event. We propose the Cross-Site Transformer, which introduces a hemodynamically informed inductive bias by restricting multi-sensor fusion to cross-attention between PPG sites. On WildPPG, the largest in-the-wild benchmark available, our model establishes a new single-model state of the art, reducing error by 21% over the previous best and 35% over the best prior transformer. The same cross-site restriction makes the trained network directly auditable. Because each cross-attention head lies on one directed pathway between sites, causal resample ablation can isolate and test each direction of information flow. Ablating the chest-to-wrist pathway doubles error, whereas the reverse costs far less. Encoding hemodynamic structure into attention routing thus improves real-world sensing robustness an…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Contexture: Runtime Context Eviction for High-Throughput Agent Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM agent（Hermes、OpenClaw、Codex 等）反复重发不断增长的执行历史，推高共享 GPU KV cache 需求并限制服务吞吐；现有上下文缩减方法缺全局 cache 状态可见性，运行时 KV 管理器又缺工具执行信息。

方法：把 token 追溯到产生它的工具操作，发现后发操作取代先发输出与相关轮次，64% 的最终历史 token 被识别为可移除候选；Contexture 把 harness 完整对话历史与模型执行上下文分离，结合工具执行信息与共享 KV 压力/前缀驻留的全局可见性做运行时驱逐。

关键数字：SLO 下吞吐比无驱逐/压缩/AgentDiet/Continuum 最优者高 20~73%；live-agent 平均准确率 +1.4 个百分点、最差 -3.7（observation masking 为 -3~28）。

为什么值得看：模型无关的 agent 服务 KV 瓶颈解法，吞吐与精度双收。

原文：Contexture: Runtime Context Eviction for High-Throughput Agent Serving

item.title: Composable Soft-Prompt Distillation of RL Experts: Toward Continual Post-Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

CSPD：可组合软提示蒸馏 RL 专家

RL post-training typically produces domain experts that must then be consolidated into one model, and as new experts keep arriving, this consolidation becomes a continual process. Weight merging and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) must re-consolidate the whole model whenever an expert is added, and can erode capabilities outside the target domains. We propose Composable Soft-Prompt Distillation (CSPD), which keeps the pre-RL model frozen, distills each RL expert independently into a soft prompt, and composes experts by concatenating their prompts without joint training. A single soft prompt suffices to distill an RL expert, recovering at least 90% of the teacher's gain in 22 of 23 math, code, and agent settings. Independently trained prompts compose well. In a multi-expert setting, the average rises with every expert added, and the full composition matches MOPD (67.83 vs. 67.79). The composition generalizes best across six held-out benchmarks. Input-space adaptation adds little serving overhead, keeping throughput within 1.5% of the unadapted backbone and reaching 2.40x that of rank-4 LoRA. These results point toward continual post-training on a fixed backbone.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Cannot Wait to Verify: Parallel Drafting to Eliminate Verifier Idle Time in Speculative Decoding
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：自回归推理受 token 级串行执行限制，投机解码（SD）用草稿-验证模型缓解，但草稿阶段仍串行，验证器空闲、算力未充分利用。

方法：即插即用的自适应草稿方法：从共享隐藏状态出发并行评估多个 transformer 层，用隐藏状态空间发散度验证一致性；层间草稿状态偏差小时接受、否则执行修正步。

关键数字：NLP 任务上草稿阶段最高加速 1.65×，精度退化极小，整体保持与 SD 相同性能。

为什么值得看：无需改架构或重训即可加速草稿生成、提升硬件利用率。

原文：Cannot Wait to Verify: Parallel Drafting to Eliminate Verifier Idle Time in Speculative Decoding

item.title: CTRL: Concurrent Training and Rollout for LLM Reinforcement Learning via GPU Co-Residency
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM RL 后训练跑两种硬件需求不同的 GPU 负载：内存访问主导、batch 随回答完成而收缩的 rollout 解码，以及稠密 learner；现有系统要么时间分片（串行阶段+切换）、要么整设备分池。

方法：CTRL 把 co-residency 做成第三种执行布局：每张 GPU 在 CUDA MPS 下运行 learner rank 与持久 rollout 引擎共享设备；host 端 learner 让优化器状态留在 host 内存、策略权重逐层流过有界 GPU 窗口；publication gate 保证无丢批的 staleness 界，step-time 界指导算力份额选择。

关键数字：H100/A800/RTX 4090 + Qwen3 上 24 个设置中达 verl 异步基线更强者的 1.11~2.24× 吞吐；同 learner 下 co-residency 比时间分片快 1.10~1.26×。

为什么值得看：RL 后训练执行布局新范式，吞吐收益跨平台一致。

原文：CTRL: Concurrent Training and Rollout for LLM Reinforcement Learning via GPU Co-Residency

item.title: BusemannFormer: Horospherical Self-Attention for Hyperbolic Graph Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

BusemannFormer：双曲图 Transformer 的等距自注意力

Hyperbolic neural networks excel on hierarchical graph data, yet existing hyperbolic Transformers largely adapt conventional attention without explicitly exploiting the ideal boundary, a geometric structure closely tied to tree hierarchy. We propose Horospherical Self-Attention (HSA): each query selects an ideal-boundary direction and scores keys by their Busemann depth along that direction, yielding a token-to-token hyperbolic attention kernel. We establish a flat-limit connection to dot-product attention, characterize score level sets as horospheres, and bound key-side gradients. HSA is integrated into BusemannFormer, a fully hyperbolic graph Transformer, with a log-depth variant that uses query depth to modulate attention concentration. We further introduce a finite-boundary-dictionary extension supporting linear-complexity global attention. Experiments on hierarchical and citation graphs show that BusemannFormer-LD outperforms the evaluated baselines on several node-classification benchmarks and achieves competitive performance across diverse graph structures.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Benchmarking EEG feature families for ADHD research in children and adolescents: performance and explainability across attention tasks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder varies in presentation. Diagnosis requires clinical and developmental assessment. Reproducible electroencephalography measures may complement clinical and behavioural characterisation, but differing feature definitions and evaluation methods hinder comparison. We compared seven feature families and four combinations across attention tasks and assessed the stability of held-out explanations. Two serious games yielded four overlapping attention-task cohorts of 123-140 participants each. Repeated nested participant-held-out evaluation assessed recruitment-group discrimination. Exploratory paired participant-cluster bootstrap tests corrected for multiplicity in two separate families: 72 individual-task contrasts and 18 fusion contrasts. For eight configurations selected after inspecting predictive results, we explained held-out native probabilities before calibration. In the strongest task context, the highest configuration mean AUROC over three repetitions was 0.773, with a fixed-prediction 95% interval of 0.692-0.854 unadjusted for selecting the maximum. Precision, sensitivity and specificity were 0.740, 0.556 and 0.861. In that task, the pair…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Auditing and Adapting kNNGuard for Long-Context Prompts
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

kNNGuard 长上下文提示的审计与适配

Training-free activation guardrails such as kNNGuard score prompts by comparing last-token LLM hidden states (the Layer Ensemble branch, kNNGuard LE) and sentence embeddings (all-MiniLM-L6-v2, Embedding-kNN) against a small reference bank (50 examples per class), combining the two branches into a Fused Ensemble (kNNGuard FE). While effective on short inputs (up to 256 tokens), standard kNNGuard degrades substantially on long inputs (over 1000 tokens): averaged across Qwen3.5-4B and Gemma-4-E4B-it, kNNGuard LE AUROC drops from 0.742 (0.777 and 0.706) to 0.554 (0.587 and 0.521) on Content Harm Moderation (Aegis-2.0), and from 0.994 (0.995 and 0.992) to 0.556 (0.598 and 0.513) on RAG Hallucination Detection (HaluBench). We trace this degradation to three causes: (1) hidden-state drift as sequence length increases, (2) hard 256-token truncation in MiniLM, and (3) signal dilution when a long document is compressed into a single final-token vector. We then evaluate three training-free adaptations: a Length-Routed Dual Bank, a long-context embedding model (Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B), and Strided Window Pooling across intermediate token positions. item.title: Asynchronous Byzantine Lattice Agreement with Logarithmic Response Time and Optimal Resilience
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

异步拜占庭格点一致协议，对数响应时间与最优弹性

Lattice agreement is a fundamental coordination primitive in which processes decide on comparable values rather than identical ones. In the asynchronous message-passing setting with Byzantine failures, existing algorithms either require authentication or do not simultaneously achieve optimal resilience and logarithmic response time. We present an asynchronous Byzantine lattice agreement algorithm that tolerates up to $f$ Byzantine failures among $n>3f$ processes, requires no authentication, and completes in $O(\log f)$ time. The algorithm builds on the classifier-tree framework of Attiya and Rachman, replacing shared-memory communication with quorum-based message passing. The main challenge is preserving the information-flow invariants underlying the classifier tree despite Byzantine behavior. To address this challenge, we introduce Supported Reliable Broadcast (SRB), a communication abstraction that combines reliable broadcast with protocol-specific admissibility checks. Messages are disseminated using reliable broadcast, but are delivered to the protocol only after verifying that they are consistent with previously propagated information about the sender's state. item.title: Adaptive Warm-State Retention for Serverless Cold-Start Mitigation: Treating Keep-Alive Time as an Online Control Parameter
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

Serverless platforms are easy to operate but pay a recurring price in cold starts: when a function is called after sitting idle, its execution environment must be rebuilt before the request can run, and latency suffers. The usual fix keeps idle environments alive for a fixed window, but a single value rarely fits a changing workload: too high wastes idle capacity, too low causes avoidable cold starts. We argue the keep-alive window should not be a fixed deployment constant; instead we treat it as a per-function runtime parameter, adjusted online from what the system observes, kept separate from how many replicas to run. We build an external retention controller for OpenFaaS/faasd that needs no platform changes, driven by two simple agents: a reactive AIMD (Additive-Increase Multiplicative-Decrease) rule and a UCB1 multi-armed bandit. Against fixed-timeout baselines and a predictive histogram keep-alive, on steady, bursty, and trace-derived workloads (Huawei Serverless 2023), the bandit cuts the aggregate cold-start rate from 63% under immediate scale-to-zero to 3%, holds P95 tail latency at the level of the longest-retention fixed baseline, and uses about 13% less accumulated warm …

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：云-边部署让资源受限机器人能异步双系统 VLN，但推理与通信延迟导致潜在失配与导航错误；现有自适应方法复用历史引导，无法在引导不再适用时提供新导航信息。

方法：AceVLN 免训练框架：分析发现动作相关失配集中在紧凑 Critical Subspace、可用快系统特征漂移追踪；用 Critical Feature Drift Entropy 反映导航敏感度并指导自适应刷新，Critical Drift Continuity 判断延迟尖峰时能否用近期潜在更新补偿；集成子空间解耦失配建模、熵引导刷新调度与连续性引导补偿。

关键数字：成功率比最强基线高 1.7~2.4 个百分点，均摊计算时间降 2.7~10.0%、FLOPs 降 18.4~22.3%。

为什么值得看：免训练的云边 VLN 延迟补偿方案，机器人部署可直接采用。

原文：AceVLN: Asynchronous Cloud Edge Deployment of VLNs via Latent Scheduling and Compensation

item.title: Acceleration of Sparse and Irregular Workloads through Energy-Efficient Stream Extensions
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

面向稀疏不规则负载的能效流扩展指令集加速

The slowdown of Moore's law and Dennard scaling has motivated computer architects to uphold performance scaling through architectural specialization. So far, most efforts have focused on highly regular workloads, which exhibit good data locality, ample reuse, and a data-independent execution flow. As this specialization hits diminishing returns, attention shifts towards sparse and irregular workloads, which are essential to applications like sparse neural networks, multiphysics simulations, and graph analytics. However, they lack the convenient properties of highly regular compute that modern architectures are optimized for, resulting in very low (<10%) functional unit utilization on traditional CPUs and GPUs. The most promising approaches to their general hardware acceleration leverage memory streams, which decouple data movement from execution. In this thesis, we explore energy-efficient hardware stream extensions that significantly accelerate sparse and irregular workloads in general-purpose systems without specializing to specific application domains or compromising on regular-workload performance. We design a flexible, core-coupled stream extension supporting affine and indire…

item.title: Accelerating Muon with Spectral Residual Correction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

AIMuon：谱残差修正加速 Muon 优化器

Muon constructs matrix updates by applying a matrix-sign transformation to momentum. A common route to accelerating Muon is to modify the gradient or momentum before this transformation. We explore a complementary direction: refining the parameter step while retaining Muon's momentum recursion. Derived from the parameter subproblem of the ADMM-Inspired Momentum framework, AIMuon uses the gradient--momentum residual to correct the tentative spectral step. The residual undergoes a separate matrix-sign transformation, while spectral--nuclear duality determines the relative weighting of the momentum and residual directions. In practice, both directions are approximated with Newton--Schulz iterations and their combination is rescaled to match Muon's update magnitude. We establish a stochastic stationarity bound for the corresponding exact iteration. On GPT-2-small, GPT-2-medium, and Qwen3-0.6B, AIMuon reaches Muon's final validation loss with 8.98\%, 10.05\%, and 6.49\% fewer optimization steps, respectively, while achieving lower final validation loss than Muon, Muon-Nesterov, and MONA.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: AV-FLARE: Feature-Level Reliability Estimation for Multimodal Emotion Recognition
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

Multimodal emotion recognition (MMER) systems typically rely on learned feature representations and attention mechanisms that implicitly weight information across time and modalities. However, these mechanisms do not explicitly incorporate input reliability, despite the presence of noise in audio, occlusions in visual data, and the sparse and event-driven nature of affective cues. We propose AV-FLARE, a framework that explicitly estimates fine-grained reliability scores across both temporal and feature dimensions prior to temporal modeling and uses them to modulate feature representations. Reliability is computed using two complementary components: (i) a supervised network trained jointly with the classification objective, and (ii) an unsupervised Gaussian Mixture Model that models global feature distributions. These signals are combined to provide both task-driven and distribution-aware reliability estimates. To integrate modalities, we introduce a hierarchical cross-modal attention mechanism in which textual features are used to guide audio-visual fusion as a semantic reference modality. Experiments on the IEMOCAP dataset show that AV-FLARE improves over a no-reliability baseline…

item.title: A Methodologically Rigorous Benchmark of Linear Regression,RNN, and LSTM for S&P 500 Forecasting:Identifying Sources of Performance Inflation in Financial DeepLearning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-20　分类：论文PDF

S&P500 预测线性回归/RNN/LSTM 严格基准

This study examines one-day-ahead forecasting of the S&P 500 closing level using a 2006-2025 dataset that includes fundamental price data, macroeconomic indicators, and engineered technical features. We benchmark three model families, namely linear regression, vanilla recurrent neural networks (RNN), and long short-term memory networks (LSTM), within a unified preprocessing and chronological evaluation pipeline. A central contribution of this work is a methodological audit of common practices in the deep-learning-for-stock-prediction literature. We identify three sources of result inflation that frequently appear in published methodologies: wavelet-denoised evaluation targets, the absence of a naive persistence baseline, and best-of-N replicate reporting. We then re-evaluate all model families under a corrected protocol that controls for each. Performance is reported using root mean squared error, mean absolute percentage error, and the Pearson correlation coefficient, averaged across N = 30 independent replicates per configuration. item.title: TideCache: Efficient Hybrid LLM Serving with Transparent Cache Management and Layer-Wise Streaming
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：混合架构开源模型（全局注意力层+有界状态层）缓存异构，需求随上下文长度与并发变化，GPU 显存分配与驻留管理困难。

方法：TideCache 三组件：Transparent Cache Pool 在固定虚拟地址后重分布物理页、保持缓存布局与后端接口；Cache Streamer 利用有界状态层计算间隔预取下一全局注意力层前缀；Request Scheduler 按请求大小与队列状态选择驻留或流式执行并触发容量调整。

关键数字：GB300/GH200 七种模型/平台配置上，相对 SGLang+HiCache 完成的 agent turns 最多 2.04×，P50 per-token 延迟降 20–59%，agent P50 TTFT 改善 1.40–3.05×。

为什么值得看：层间流式重叠把释放的 HBM 用于更多请求，混合架构 serving 的实用方案。
